Hãy lấp đầy túi đựng tên! \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã thúc giục các vua Mê-đi tấn công, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã quyết định hủy diệt Ba-by-lôn. \q Đây là cách {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} báo trả Ba-by-lôn, \q vì nó đã phá hủy đền thờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 화살을 날카롭게 하여라. 화살통을 채워라! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 메대 왕들의 마음을 일으키셨다. \q 바빌론을 멸망시키는 것이 그분의 뜻이기 때문이다. \q 이것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 복수, \q 그분의 성전을 위한 복수다.
ko.B: 화살을 날카롭게 갈아라! 화살통을 가득 채워라! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 메대 왕들의 마음을 움직이셨다. \q 바빌론을 멸망시키는 것이 그분의 계획이기 때문이다. \q 이것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 복수, \q 그분의 성전을 위한 복수다.
ko.R: 화살을 날카롭게 갈아라! 화살통을 화살로 가득 채워라! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 메대 왕들의 마음을 움직여 공격하게 하셨다. \q 그분께서 바빌론을 멸망시키기로 정하셨기 때문이다. \q 이것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 바빌론에게 갚으시는 일이다. \q 바빌론이 그분의 성전을 무너뜨렸기 때문이다.

pt.L: Afiem as flechas; encham as aljavas! \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} despertou o espírito dos reis dos medos, \q pois o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} propósito contra a Babilônia é destruí-la; \q pois esta é a vingança {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, \q a vingança pelo {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} templo.
pt.B: Afiem as flechas! Encham as aljavas! \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} despertou o espírito dos reis dos medos, \q porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} plano é destruir a Babilônia. \q Esta é a vingança {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, \q a vingança pelo {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} templo.
pt.R: Afiem as flechas! Encham as suas bolsas de flechas! \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} levou os reis dos medos a atacar, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} decidiu destruir a Babilônia. \q É assim que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} vai fazer a Babilônia pagar, \q porque ela destruiu o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} templo.

am.L: ፍላጾችን ሳሉ፤ ሰገባዎችን ሙሉ! \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሜዶንን ነገሥታት መንፈስ አስነሥቷል፤ \q ባቢሎንን ያጠፋት ዘንድ አሳቡ በእርሷ ላይ ነውና፤ \q ይህ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} በቀል፣ \q ለመቅደሱ የሚደረግ በቀል ነውና።
am.B: ፍላጾችን ሳሉ! ሰገባዎችን ሙሉ! \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሜዶንን ነገሥታት መንፈስ አነሣሥቷል፤ \q አሳቡ ባቢሎንን ማጥፋት ነውና። \q ይህ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} በቀል፣ \q ለመቅደሱ የሚደረግ በቀል ነው።
am.R: ፍላጾቻችሁን ሳሉ! ሰገባዎቻችሁን በፍላጻ ሙሉ! \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሜዶንን ነገሥታት እንዲወጉ አነሣሥቷቸዋል፤ \q ባቢሎንን ለማጥፋት ወስኗልና። \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ባቢሎንን የሚበቀለው በዚህ መንገድ ነው፤ \q ቤተ መቅደሱን አፍርሳለችና።

hi.L: तीरों को चमकाओ; तरकशों को भरो! \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मादियों के राजाओं की आत्मा को उभारा है, \q क्योंकि बाबुल के विषय में उनकी युक्ति उसे नाश करने की है; \q क्योंकि यह {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का पलटा है, \q उनके मंदिर का पलटा।
hi.B: तीरों को पैना करो! तरकशों को भर लो! \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मादी राजाओं के मन को उभारा है, \q क्योंकि उनकी योजना बाबुल को नाश करने की है। \q यह {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का पलटा है, \q उनके मंदिर का पलटा।
hi.R: अपने तीर पैने करो! अपने तरकश तीरों से भर लो! \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मादियों के राजाओं को हमला करने के लिए उकसाया है, \q क्योंकि उन्होंने बाबुल को नाश करने का निश्चय किया है। \q इस तरह {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} बाबुल से बदला चुकाएँगे, \q क्योंकि उसने उनके मंदिर को नष्ट किया।

ru.L: Заострите стрелы, наполните колчаны! \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} возбудил дух царей Мидии, \q ведь {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} замысел о Вавилоне — погубить его; \q ведь это отмщение {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, \q отмщение за {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} храм.
ru.B: Точите стрелы! Наполняйте колчаны! \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} пробудил дух мидийских царей, \q потому что {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} замысел — погубить Вавилон. \q Это отмщение {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, \q отмщение за {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} храм.
ru.R: Точите стрелы! Наполняйте колчаны стрелами! \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} побудил царей Мидии напасть, \q потому что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} решил погубить Вавилон. \q Так {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} воздаст Вавилону \q за то, что тот разрушил {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} храм.

ja.L: 矢を研げ。矢筒を満たせ。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はメディアの王たちの霊を奮い立たせられた。 \q その方の計画はバビロンに向けられ、それを滅ぼすことだからだ。 \q それは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の報復、 \q その方の神殿のための報復である。
ja.B: 矢を研げ。矢筒を満たせ。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はメディアの王たちの心を奮い立たせられた。 \q その方の計画は、バビロンを滅ぼすことだからだ。 \q これは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の報復、 \q その方の神殿のための報復である。
ja.R: 矢を研ぐがいい！矢筒を矢でいっぱいにするがいい！ \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、メディアの王たちの心を動かして、攻めさせられた。 \q その方が、バビロンを滅ぼすと決められたからだ。 \q こうして{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、バビロンに報いを与えられる。 \q バビロンが、その方の神殿を壊したからだ。

decisions.choice: quivers: probably the cases that hold arrows; possibly shields
decisions.reason: The word is rare (2 Samuel 8:7; Ezekiel 27:11; Song 4:4). It is often taken as "shields", but "fill the shields" is a strange command, and beside "sharpen the arrows" it most likely means quivers, which are filled with arrows. If it means shields, the sense may be "take up the shields" or "fit the shields", that is, make ready for battle.

decisions.choice: the kings of the Medes: the rulers of Media and its allied peoples
decisions.reason: Media lay in the mountains east of Babylonia. Its kings had joined Babylon to destroy Assyria in the seventh century BC, but by the sixth century Media was part of the empire of Cyrus the Persian, and Medes were among the forces that took Babylon in 539 BC (Isaiah 13:17; Daniel 5:28-31). "Kings" may include the lesser kings under Media's rule (verse 28).

decisions.choice: the vengeance for his temple: for Babylon's burning of the temple in Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Babylon burned the LORD's house in 587 BC (52:13). As in 50:28, the destruction of Babylon is the LORD's answer to that act.

decisions.choice: moved ... to attack; because she destroyed his temple
decisions.reason: Readable explains "stirred up the spirit" and says what the vengeance for the temple is for (m3). It says "bags with arrows" for quivers.

decisions.choice: los medos (L, R); Media (B)
decisions.reason: The Medes, as published 2 Kings 17:6.

decisions.choice: các vua Mê-đi
decisions.reason: The Medes are written as the published form of Acts 2:9 ("người Mê-đi").

decisions.choice: "화살통"; "메대 왕들"
decisions.reason: The English reads quivers (the meaning decision leaves "shields" possible); 메대 is the Protestant form for the Medes.

decisions.choice: os medos; a vingança pelo seu templo
decisions.reason: "Os medos" as Isaiah 13:17 has them in Portuguese; "a vingança pelo seu templo" keeps the words of 50:28.

decisions.choice: quivers are "ሰገባዎች", as Genesis 27:3; the Medes are "ሜዶን", as 2 Kings 17:6 and Jeremiah 25:25.
decisions.reason: The meaning decision prefers quivers; the names keep the forms on main.
The Medes are "मादी", as Isaiah 13:17 and Daniel.

decisions.choice: колчаны; Мидия, мидийские
decisions.reason: The word is probably the case that holds arrows, possibly shields (m1); Russian follows the English. Media keeps the form of Isaiah 21:2 and Acts 2:9 in this translation (m2).

decisions.choice: shelatim "矢筒" (footnoted); malkhei Madai "メディアの王たち" (ISA 13:17 メディア人); the vengeance for the temple in the 50:28 forms.
decisions.reason: m1-m3: the ISA name form and the JER repeated phrase.

source.text: אֶל־חוֹמֹ֨ת בָּבֶ֜ל שְׂאוּ־נֵ֗ס הַחֲזִ֨יקוּ֙ הַמִּשְׁמָ֔ר הָקִ֨ימוּ֙ שֹֽׁמְרִ֔ים הָכִ֖ינוּ הָאֹֽרְבִ֑ים כִּ֚י גַּם־זָמַ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה גַּם־עָשָׂ֕ה אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֖ר אֶל־יֹשְׁבֵ֥י בָבֶֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Against [the] walls of Babylon lift up a signal flag; strengthen the watch; station watchmen; prepare the ambushes; for both has planned Yahweh, also he has done what he spoke concerning [the] inhabitants of Babylon.

en.L: Against the walls of Babylon raise a signal flag; \q strengthen the watch, station watchmen, \q prepare the ambushes! \q For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has both planned and done \q what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke concerning the inhabitants of Babylon.
en.B: Raise a signal flag against the walls of Babylon! \q Strengthen the guard, post the watchmen, \q set the ambushes! \q For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has planned it, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done it: \q what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said against the people of Babylon.
en.R: Raise a signal flag to attack the walls of Babylon! \q Put more guards on watch. Post the watchmen. \q Get men ready to hide and attack by surprise! \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has planned what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} would do to the people of Babylon, \q and now {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done it.

es.L: Contra los muros de Babilonia {{plural_you:alcen|alzad}} bandera; \q {{plural_you:refuercen|reforzad}} la guardia, {{plural_you:pongan|poned}} centinelas, \q {{plural_you:preparen|preparad}} emboscadas. \q Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo ha planeado y también lo ha hecho, \q lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} habló contra los habitantes de Babilonia.
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Alcen|Alzad}} una bandera contra los muros de Babilonia! \q {{plural_you:Refuercen|Reforzad}} la guardia, {{plural_you:pongan|poned}} centinelas, \q {{plural_you:preparen|preparad}} las emboscadas. \q Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo ha planeado y lo ha hecho: \q lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dijo contra la gente de Babilonia.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Alcen|Alzad}} una bandera para atacar los muros de Babilonia! \q {{plural_you:Pongan|Poned}} más guardias. {{plural_you:Coloquen|Colocad}} a los centinelas. \q ¡{{plural_you:Preparen|Preparad}} hombres para que se escondan y ataquen por sorpresa! \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} planeó lo que dijo que haría a la gente de Babilonia, \q y ahora lo ha hecho.

fr.L: Contre les murailles de Babylone levez un étendard ; \q renforcez la garde, postez des sentinelles, \q préparez les embuscades ! \q Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a à la fois projeté et fait \q ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a dit contre les habitants de Babylone.
fr.B: Levez un étendard contre les murailles de Babylone ! \q Renforcez la garde, postez les sentinelles, \q dressez les embuscades ! \q Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’a projeté, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a fait : \q ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a dit contre les habitants de Babylone.
fr.R: Levez un drapeau pour attaquer les murailles de Babylone ! \q Mettez plus de gardes en faction. Postez les sentinelles. \q Préparez des hommes pour se cacher et attaquer par surprise ! \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait prévu ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a dit qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ferait aux habitants de Babylone, \q et maintenant {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a fait.

sw.L: Juu ya kuta za Babeli inueni bendera; \q imarisheni ulinzi, wekeni walinzi, \q andaeni waviziao! \q Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amekusudia na pia ametenda \q aliyosema juu ya wakaaji wa Babeli.
sw.B: Inueni bendera dhidi ya kuta za Babeli! \q Imarisheni ulinzi, wekeni walinzi, \q tegeni waviziao! \q Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amekusudia, naye ametenda \q yale aliyosema dhidi ya watu wa Babeli.
sw.R: Inueni bendera ya kushambulia kuta za Babeli! \q Ongezeni walinzi. Wekeni walinzi mahali pao. \q Andaeni watu wajifiche na kushambulia ghafula! \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alipanga yale aliyosema atawatendea watu wa Babeli, \q na sasa ameyatenda.

vi.L: Hãy dựng cờ hiệu nghịch cùng tường thành Ba-by-lôn; \q hãy tăng cường canh gác, đặt lính canh, \q chuẩn bị các toán phục kích! \q Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã vừa định vừa làm \q điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán về dân cư Ba-by-lôn.
vi.B: Hãy dựng cờ hiệu nghịch cùng tường thành Ba-by-lôn! \q Hãy tăng cường lính gác, đặt người canh, \q bố trí các toán phục kích! \q Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã định, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm: \q điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán nghịch cùng dân Ba-by-lôn.
vi.R: Hãy dựng cờ hiệu để tấn công tường thành Ba-by-lôn! \q Hãy tăng thêm lính gác. Hãy đặt người canh. \q Hãy chuẩn bị người mai phục để đánh bất ngờ! \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã định điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ làm cho dân Ba-by-lôn, \q và nay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm.

ko.L: 바빌론 성벽을 향하여 깃발을 올려라. \q 파수를 강화하고, 파수꾼들을 세우고, \q 복병을 준비하여라! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 바빌론 주민들에 관하여 \q 말씀하신 것을 계획하셨고 또 이루셨기 때문이다.
ko.B: 바빌론 성벽을 향하여 신호 깃발을 올려라! \q 경계를 강화하고, 파수꾼들을 세우고, \q 매복을 준비하여라! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 계획하셨고, 또 이루셨다. \q 바빌론 사람들에 관하여 말씀하신 것을 이루셨다.
ko.R: 바빌론 성벽을 공격하려고 깃발을 올려라! \q 보초를 더 세우고, 파수꾼들을 배치하여라. \q 숨어 있다가 갑자기 공격할 사람들을 준비시켜라! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 바빌론 사람들에게 하겠다고 말씀하신 일을 계획하셨다. \q 그리고 이제 그 일을 이루셨다.

pt.L: Contra os muros da Babilônia levantem uma bandeira; \q reforcem a guarda, ponham sentinelas, \q preparem as emboscadas! \q Pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tanto planejou como fez \q o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} falou contra os moradores da Babilônia.
pt.B: Levantem uma bandeira de sinal contra os muros da Babilônia! \q Reforcem a guarda, ponham as sentinelas, \q preparem as emboscadas! \q Pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} planejou, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez \q o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} disse contra o povo da Babilônia.
pt.R: Levantem uma bandeira de sinal para atacar os muros da Babilônia! \q Ponham mais guardas de vigia. Coloquem as sentinelas. \q Preparem homens para se esconder e atacar de surpresa! \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} planejou o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} disse que ia fazer com o povo da Babilônia, \q e agora {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez isso.

am.L: በባቢሎን ቅጥሮች ላይ ዓላማ አንሡ፤ \q ጥበቃውን አጽኑ፤ ጠባቂዎችን አቁሙ፤ \q ድብቅ ጦርን አዘጋጁ! \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አቅዷልና፤ ደግሞም አድርጓል፤ \q በባቢሎን ነዋሪዎች ላይ የተናገረውን።
am.B: በባቢሎን ቅጥሮች ላይ የምልክት ዓላማ አንሡ! \q ጥበቃውን አጠናክሩ፤ ጠባቂዎችን አቁሙ፤ \q ድብቅ ጦርን አዘጋጁ! \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አቅዶታልና፤ አድርጎታልም፤ \q በባቢሎን ሕዝብ ላይ የተናገረውን።
am.R: የባቢሎንን ቅጥሮች ለመውጋት የምልክት ዓላማ አንሡ! \q ጠባቂዎችን አብዙ፤ ዘበኞችን አቁሙ። \q ተደብቀው በድንገት የሚያጠቁ ሰዎችን አዘጋጁ! \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በባቢሎን ሕዝብ ላይ አደርጋለሁ ያለውን አቅዷል፤ \q አሁንም አድርጎታል።

hi.L: बाबुल की शहरपनाह के विरुद्ध झंडा खड़ा करो; \q पहरा मज़बूत करो, पहरुए बैठाओ, \q घात लगानेवालों को तैयार करो! \q क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने ठाना भी है और किया भी है \q जो उन्होंने बाबुल के निवासियों के विषय में कहा था।
hi.B: बाबुल की शहरपनाह के विरुद्ध झंडा खड़ा करो! \q पहरा कड़ा करो, पहरुए तैनात करो, \q घात लगाओ! \q क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने यह ठाना है, और उन्होंने यह कर दिखाया है: \q वही जो उन्होंने बाबुल के लोगों के विरुद्ध कहा था।
hi.R: बाबुल की दीवारों पर हमला करने के लिए झंडा खड़ा करो! \q और पहरेदार लगाओ। पहरुए तैनात करो। \q ऐसे लोग तैयार करो जो छिपकर अचानक हमला करें! \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने बाबुल के लोगों के साथ जो करने को कहा था, उसकी योजना उन्होंने बनाई, \q और अब उन्होंने वह कर दिया है।

ru.L: На стены Вавилона поднимите знамя; \q усильте стражу, поставьте сторожей, \q приготовьте засады! \q Ведь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} и замыслил, и сделал \q то, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} говорил о жителях Вавилона.
ru.B: Поднимите знамя против стен Вавилона! \q Усильте охрану, поставьте сторожей, \q устройте засады! \q Ведь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} это замыслил, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} это сделал, \q то, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сказал против жителей Вавилона.
ru.R: Поднимите знамя, чтобы напасть на стены Вавилона! \q Поставьте больше стражи. Расставьте сторожей. \q Приготовьте людей, чтобы они спрятались и напали внезапно! \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} замыслил то, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} обещал сделать с жителями Вавилона, \q и теперь {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} это сделал.

ja.L: バビロンの城壁に向かって旗を揚げよ。 \q 見張りを強め、見張りの者たちを立てよ。 \q 伏兵を備えよ。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、バビロンの住民について語られたことを、 \q 計画し、また行われたからだ。
ja.B: バビロンの城壁に向かって合図の旗を掲げよ。 \q 見張りを固め、見張りの者たちを配置せよ。 \q 伏兵を備えよ。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は計画し、それを行われた。 \q バビロンの住民について語られたことを。
ja.R: バビロンの城壁を攻めるために、合図の旗を立てるがいい！ \q 見張りを増やし、見張りの者たちを立てるがいい。 \q 隠れて不意を突く兵士たちを備えるがいい！ \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、バビロンの人々にすると言われたことを計画しておられた。 \q そして今、それを行われたのだ。

decisions.choice: raise ... strengthen ... prepare: orders to the attackers to set the siege
decisions.reason: The commands most likely speak to the armies coming against Babylon: raise the flag that calls the troops, keep a close watch around the city so no one escapes, and set men in hiding to catch any who try. They could also be mocking orders to Babylon's defenders, who will strengthen the watch in vain. Either way, the second half says the outcome is the LORD's.

decisions.choice: signal flag: a banner raised on a pole to gather troops
decisions.reason: As in Isaiah, the *nes* is a flag or banner raised on a height as a rallying sign (4:6; 50:2; 51:27).

decisions.choice: both planned and done: what the LORD intends, he carries out
decisions.reason: The two verbs together say that his purpose and his act are one (4:28; Lamentations 2:17). Babylon's fall is not chance but the fulfillment of his word.

decisions.choice: men ready to hide and attack by surprise
decisions.reason: Readable explains "ambushes" in plain words.

decisions.choice: Battle summons "〜せよ" (L, B), "〜するがいい" (R); nes "旗" (L), "合図の旗" (B, R); the LORD with respect forms (語られた, 行われた).
decisions.reason: m1: orders to the besiegers.

source.text: שֹׁכַנְתְּ֙ עַל־מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֔ים רַבַּ֖ת אֽוֹצָרֹ֑ת בָּ֥א קִצֵּ֖ךְ אַמַּ֥ת בִּצְעֵֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: [You who] dwell on many waters, great of treasures, has come your end, [the] cubit of your cutting off.

en.L: You who dwell by many waters, \q rich in treasures, \q your end has come, the cubit of your cutting off.
en.B: You who live beside many waters, \q you with your wealth of treasures, \q your end has come; the thread of your life is measured to be cut.
en.R: You live beside many rivers and canals, \q and you have great treasures. \q But your end has come. Your life will be cut off like thread cut from a loom.

es.L: Tú que habitas junto a muchas aguas, \q rica en tesoros, \q ha llegado tu fin, la medida de tu corte.
es.B: Tú que vives junto a muchas aguas, \q tú que tienes tantos tesoros, \q ha llegado tu fin; el hilo de tu vida está medido para ser cortado.
es.R: Vives junto a muchos ríos y canales, \q y tienes grandes tesoros. \q Pero ha llegado tu fin. Tu vida será cortada como el hilo que se corta del telar.

fr.L: Toi qui habites près des grandes eaux, \q riche en trésors, \q ta fin est venue, la mesure de ton retranchement.
fr.B: Toi qui habites au bord des grandes eaux, \q toi qui regorges de trésors, \q ta fin est venue ; le fil de ta vie est mesuré pour être coupé.
fr.R: Tu habites au bord de nombreux fleuves et canaux, \q et tu possèdes de grands trésors. \q Mais ta fin est arrivée. Ta vie sera coupée comme le fil qu’on coupe sur un métier à tisser.

sw.L: Wewe ukaaye juu ya maji mengi, \q mwenye hazina nyingi, \q mwisho wako umefika, kipimo cha kukatiliwa kwako.
sw.B: Wewe unayeishi kando ya maji mengi, \q wewe mwenye wingi wa hazina, \q mwisho wako umefika; uzi wa maisha yako umepimwa ukatwe.
sw.R: Unaishi kando ya mito na mifereji mingi, \q nawe una hazina nyingi. \q Lakini mwisho wako umefika. Maisha yako yatakatwa kama uzi unaokatwa kutoka kwenye kitanda cha kufumia.

vi.L: Hỡi kẻ ở bên nhiều dòng nước, \q giàu có kho báu, \q sự cuối cùng của ngươi đã đến, là thước đo của sự cắt đứt ngươi.
vi.B: Hỡi kẻ ở bên nhiều dòng nước, \q kẻ có kho báu dồi dào, \q sự cuối cùng của ngươi đã đến; sợi chỉ đời ngươi đã được đo để cắt.
vi.R: Ngươi sống bên nhiều sông ngòi và kênh rạch, \q và ngươi có nhiều kho báu. \q Nhưng ngày tận cùng của ngươi đã đến. Đời ngươi sẽ bị cắt đứt như sợi chỉ bị cắt khỏi khung cửi.

ko.L: 많은 물가에 살며 \q 보물이 많은 자야, \q 너의 끝이 왔고, 네가 끊어질 [실의] 길이가 [찼다].
ko.B: 많은 물가에 살며 \q 보물이 넘쳐 나는 자야, \q 너의 끝이 왔다. 네 생명의 실을 잴 만큼 재었으니 이제 끊을 때다.
ko.R: 너는 많은 강과 운하 곁에 살고 \q 큰 보물을 가지고 있다. \q 그러나 너의 끝이 왔다. 베틀에서 실을 잘라 내듯이 네 생명이 끊어질 것이다.

pt.L: Tu que habitas junto a muitas águas, \q rica em tesouros, \q chegou o teu fim, o côvado do teu corte.
pt.B: Tu que moras junto a muitas águas, \q tu que tens tesouros em abundância, \q chegou o teu fim; o fio da tua vida foi medido para ser cortado.
pt.R: Moras junto a muitos rios e canais, \q e tens grandes tesouros. \q Mas chegou o teu fim. A tua vida vai ser cortada como o fio cortado do tear.

am.L: በብዙ ውኆች ላይ የተቀመጥሽ፣ \q መዝገብሽ የበዛ፣ \q ፍጻሜሽ፣ የመቆረጥሽ ክንድ መጥቷል።
am.B: በብዙ ውኆች ላይ የተቀመጥሽ፣ \q በብዙ መዝገብ የበለጸግሽ ሆይ፣ \q ፍጻሜሽ መጥቷል፤ የሕይወትሽ ፈትል ተለክቶ ሊቆረጥ ነው።
am.R: በብዙ ወንዞችና ቦዮች አጠገብ ትኖሪያለሽ፤ \q ብዙ ሀብትም አለሽ። \q ፍጻሜሽ ግን መጥቷል። ሕይወትሽ ከሸማኔ ዕቃ እንደሚቆረጥ ፈትል ይቆረጣል።

hi.L: हे बहुत से जल के पास बसनेवाली, \q ख़ज़ानों से भरपूर, \q तुम्हारा अंत आ गया है, तुम्हारे काटे जाने का हाथ भर नाप।
hi.B: हे बहुत से जल के किनारे रहनेवाली, \q हे ख़ज़ानों से भरपूर नगरी, \q तुम्हारा अंत आ गया है; तुम्हारे जीवन का धागा नापा जा चुका है कि काटा जाए।
hi.R: तुम बहुत-सी नदियों और नहरों के किनारे बसी हो, \q और तुम्हारे पास बड़े-बड़े ख़ज़ाने हैं। \q पर तुम्हारा अंत आ गया है। करघे से कटे धागे की तरह तुम्हारा जीवन काट दिया जाएगा।

ru.L: Живущий у вод многих, \q богатый сокровищами, \q пришёл твой конец, мера твоего отсечения.
ru.B: Ты, живущий у многих вод, \q ты, обладающий множеством сокровищ, \q пришёл твой конец; нить твоей жизни отмерена, чтобы её отрезать.
ru.R: Ты живёшь у многих рек и каналов, \q и у тебя огромные сокровища. \q Но пришёл твой конец. Твою жизнь отрежут, как нить, которую отрезают от ткацкого станка.

ja.L: 多くの水のほとりに住む者よ、 \q 宝に富む者よ。 \q おまえの終わりが来た、おまえの断ち切られる[糸の]尺が。
ja.B: 多くの水のほとりに住み、 \q 豊かな宝を持つ者よ。 \q おまえの終わりが来た。おまえの命の糸は、断ち切られる長さまで測られた。
ja.R: おまえは多くの川や運河のほとりに住み、 \q たくさんの宝を持っている。 \q だが、おまえの終わりが来た。おまえの命は、機織りの糸のように断ち切られる。

decisions.choice: many waters: the Euphrates and the canals of Babylon
decisions.reason: Babylon stood on the Euphrates, and a network of canals watered its fields and protected the city (Psalm 137:1). The waters that made it rich and safe could not save it (verse 36). Revelation 17:1 takes up the phrase.

decisions.choice: the cubit of your cutting off: the length of your thread has been measured, and it is cut
alternatives: the measure of your unjust gain is full
decisions.reason: A cubit was a measure of length, also used of cloth. The second word comes from a verb meaning to cut off, used of a weaver cutting the finished cloth from the loom (Isaiah 38:12). The sense is that Babylon's life has reached its measured length and is cut off. The same noun often means unjust gain, and the line could mean "the measure of your plunder is full", that is, the limit of your greed has been reached.

decisions.choice: you who dwell: an old spelling in the written text
decisions.reason: The written text spells the verb with an older ending; the text as read has the usual form. The meaning is the same (compare 22:23).

decisions.choice: the thread of your life is measured to be cut (Balanced); like thread cut from a loom (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "cubit". Balanced and Readable say what the picture means (m2); they use no measure, since "cubit" here is part of a figure of speech, not a measurement.

decisions.choice: la medida de tu corte
decisions.reason: "The cubit of your cutting off" pictures a weaver measuring the length of cloth before cutting it from the loom; Literal says "medida", and Balanced and Readable explain the picture.

decisions.choice: "네가 끊어질 [실의] 길이가 [찼다]" (L); "생명의 실을 잴 만큼 재었으니 이제 끊을 때다" (B); "베틀에서 실을 잘라 내듯이" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: the length of the thread is measured and cut; Korean keeps the weaver's picture.

decisions.choice: "you who dwell on many waters" is "በብዙ ውኆች ላይ የተቀመጥሽ", the words of Revelation 17:1 on main ("በብዙ ውኆች ላይ የተቀመጠችውን").
decisions.reason: Revelation 17:1, 15 takes up this line of Babylon; Amharic ተቀመጠ covers both the Hebrew "dwell" and the Greek "sit", so the New Testament wording fits the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "हाथ भर नाप"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the cubit as part of the picture of measured thread; it is not a measurement, so it has no units span, as the English has none.

decisions.choice: "बहुत से जल"
decisions.reason: The wording of Revelation 17:1, which takes up this line of Babylon.

decisions.choice: мера твоего отсечения (L); нить твоей жизни отмерена (B); как нить ... от ткацкого станка (R)
decisions.reason: "The cubit of your cutting off" pictures a thread measured and cut (m2); Literal keeps "мера" for the measure, since "локоть" here is part of a figure of speech, not a measure, and Balanced and Readable say what the picture means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: 'ammat bits'ekh "断ち切られる[糸の]尺" (L), B, R by the meaning decision (a measured thread cut off); Babylon addressed "おまえ".
decisions.reason: m2: the image is uncertain and footnoted.

source.text: נִשְׁבַּ֛ע יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת בְּנַפְשׁ֑וֹ כִּ֣י אִם־מִלֵּאתִ֤יךְ אָדָם֙ כַּיֶּ֔לֶק וְעָנ֥וּ עָלַ֖יִךְ הֵידָֽד׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Has sworn Yahweh of hosts by his soul: surely I will fill you [with] men like locusts, and they will raise over you a shout.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts has sworn by {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}: \q Surely I will fill you with men like locusts, \q and they will raise over you a shout [of victory].
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies has sworn by {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}: \q I will fill you with men, as many as locusts, \q and they will shout in triumph over you.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies has made a promise and sworn by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own life: \q I will fill your streets with enemy soldiers, as many as locusts, \q and they will shout over you because they have won.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos ha jurado por {{deity_pronoun:sí|Sí}} mismo: \q Ciertamente te llenaré de hombres como de langostas, \q y levantarán sobre ti grito [de victoria].
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos ha jurado por {{deity_pronoun:sí|Sí}} mismo: \q Te llenaré de hombres, tantos como langostas, \q y gritarán victoriosos sobre ti.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos ha hecho una promesa y ha jurado por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propia vida: \q Llenaré tus calles de soldados enemigos, tantos como langostas, \q y gritarán sobre ti porque han ganado.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées l’a juré par {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} : \q Oui, je te remplirai d’hommes comme de sauterelles, \q et ils pousseront contre toi un cri [de victoire].
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées l’a juré par {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} : \q Je te remplirai d’hommes aussi nombreux que les sauterelles, \q et ils pousseront contre toi des cris de triomphe.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées a fait une promesse et l’a jurée sur {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} propre vie : \q Je remplirai tes rues de soldats ennemis, aussi nombreux que les sauterelles, \q et ils pousseront des cris contre toi parce qu’ils auront gagné.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi ameapa kwa nafsi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}: \q Hakika nitakujaza watu kama nzige, \q nao watapaza juu yako kelele [za ushindi].
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi ameapa kwa nafsi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}: \q Nitakujaza watu, wengi kama nzige, \q nao watapiga kelele za ushindi juu yako.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi ametoa ahadi na kuapa kwa uhai {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe: \q Nitaijaza mitaa yako askari wa adui, wengi kama nzige, \q nao watapiga kelele juu yako kwa sababu wameshinda.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đã chỉ chính mình {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà thề: \q Chắc chắn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho ngươi đầy người như cào cào, \q và chúng sẽ hò reo [chiến thắng] trên ngươi.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đã lấy chính mình {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà thề: \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho ngươi đầy người, đông như cào cào, \q và chúng sẽ hò reo đắc thắng trên ngươi.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đã hứa và lấy chính mạng sống {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà thề: \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho đường phố ngươi đầy quân thù, đông như cào cào, \q và chúng sẽ reo hò trên ngươi vì đã thắng trận.

ko.L: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 자신을 두고 맹세하셨다. \q 내가 반드시 메뚜기 떼 같은 사람들로 너를 채우리니, \q 그들이 너를 두고 [승리의] 함성을 지를 것이다.
ko.B: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 자신을 두고 맹세하셨다. \q 내가 메뚜기 떼처럼 많은 사람으로 너를 채우리니, \q 그들이 너를 이기고 환호할 것이다.
ko.R: 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 자신의 생명을 걸고 맹세하셨다. \q 나는 메뚜기 떼처럼 많은 적군으로 네 거리를 채우겠다. \q 그들은 너를 이기고 소리쳐 기뻐할 것이다.

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos jurou por si {{deity_pronoun:mesmo|Mesmo}}: \q Certamente te encherei de homens como gafanhotos, \q e eles levantarão sobre ti um grito [de vitória].
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos jurou por si {{deity_pronoun:mesmo|Mesmo}}: \q Eu te encherei de homens, tantos quanto os gafanhotos, \q e eles gritarão em triunfo sobre ti.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos fez uma promessa e jurou pela {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} própria vida: \q Vou encher as tuas ruas de soldados inimigos, tantos quanto os gafanhotos, \q e eles vão gritar sobre ti porque venceram.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት በራሱ ምሏል፦ \q በእርግጥ እንደ አንበጣ ሰዎችን እሞላብሻለሁ፤ \q በአንቺም ላይ [የድል] ጩኸት ያሰማሉ።
am.B: የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በራሱ ምሏል፦ \q እንደ አንበጣ ብዛት ባላቸው ሰዎች እሞላሻለሁ፤ \q እነርሱም በአንቺ ላይ በድል እልል ይላሉ።
am.R: የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ቃል ገብቶ በሕይወቱ ምሏል፦ \q መንገዶችሽን እንደ አንበጣ ብዙ በሆኑ የጠላት ወታደሮች እሞላለሁ፤ \q ድል ስላደረጉም በአንቺ ላይ ይጮኻሉ።

hi.L: सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने अपने ही प्राण की शपथ खाई है: \q निश्चय मैं तुम्हें टिड्डियों की तरह मनुष्यों से भर दूँगा, \q और वे तुम पर [जय की] ललकार करेंगे।
hi.B: सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने अपनी ही शपथ खाई है: \q मैं तुम्हें टिड्डियों जितने मनुष्यों से भर दूँगा, \q और वे तुम पर जीत की ललकार करेंगे।
hi.R: सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने अपने ही जीवन की शपथ खाकर वचन दिया है: \q मैं तुम्हारी सड़कों को टिड्डियों जितने शत्रु सैनिकों से भर दूँगा, \q और वे जीत जाने के कारण तुम पर ललकारेंगे।

ru.L: Поклялся {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф самим собой: \q Истинно, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} наполню тебя людьми, как саранчой, \q и они поднимут над тобой клич [победы].
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф поклялся самим собой: \q Я наполню тебя людьми, многочисленными, как саранча, \q и они с торжеством закричат над тобой.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств дал обещание и поклялся своей жизнью: \q Я наполню твои улицы вражескими воинами, многочисленными, как саранча, \q и они будут кричать над тобой, потому что победили.

ja.L: 万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はご自身にかけて誓われた。 \q 必ず、わたしはいなごのような人々でおまえを満たす。 \q 彼らはおまえに向かって、[勝利の]叫びを上げる。
ja.B: 万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はご自身にかけて誓われた。 \q わたしは、いなごのように多くの人々でおまえを満たす。 \q 彼らはおまえに向かって勝利の叫びを上げる。
ja.R: 天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ご自分の命にかけて誓い、約束された。 \q わたしは、いなごのように多くの敵の兵士で、おまえの通りを満たす。 \q 彼らは、勝ったと言って、おまえに向かって叫ぶ。

decisions.choice: has sworn by himself: the strongest oath possible
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "by his soul", that is, by his own life. Since there is none greater, God swears by himself (22:5; 49:13; Genesis 22:16; Amos 6:8; Hebrews 6:13).

decisions.choice: surely: the form of an oath
decisions.reason: The words "for if" introduce the content of an oath and mean "surely" (Numbers 14:28).

decisions.choice: like locusts ... a shout: an army past counting, shouting over its prey
decisions.reason: Locust swarms stood for numbers beyond counting (46:23; Judges 6:5). The shout is the cry of grape treaders, here a victory shout (25:30; 48:33).

decisions.choice: [of victory] (L); in triumph (B); because they have won (R)
decisions.reason: The word names a loud rhythmic shout; in this setting it is a shout over the defeated, so Literal supplies "[of victory]" and Balanced and Readable say so.

decisions.choice: "अपने ही" without a span
decisions.reason: Hindi has no deity_pronoun spans; the reflexive "अपने" would not take one in any case.

decisions.choice: самим собой, своей жизнью, no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The English has a span on "himself"; Russian says "собой / своей", which is reflexive and takes no span in this translation, as 49:13 and Genesis 22:16.

decisions.choice: The oath announced with a respect form (誓われた), then God's own words plain (わたしは…満たす); 'arbeh / yeleq "いなご" (kana).
decisions.reason: m1: the narrator's words about God, then God speaking.

source.text: עֹשֵׂ֥ה אֶ֨רֶץ֙ בְּכֹח֔וֹ מֵכִ֥ין תֵּבֵ֖ל בְּחָכְמָת֑וֹ וּבִתְבוּנָת֖וֹ נָטָ֥ה שָׁמָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: [He is the] maker of [the] earth by his power, establisher of [the] world by his wisdom, and by his understanding he stretched out [the] heavens.

en.L: [He is] the maker of the earth by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power, \q who established the world by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wisdom, \q and by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} understanding {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} stretched out the heavens.
en.B: It is {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} who made the earth by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power, \q who set the world firm by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wisdom, \q and by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} understanding spread out the heavens.
en.R: God made the earth by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power. \q He set the world firmly in place by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wisdom. \q He used {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} understanding to spread out the sky.

es.L: [Él es] el que hizo la tierra con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder, \q el que afirmó el mundo con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} sabiduría, \q y con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} inteligencia extendió los cielos.
es.B: Es {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quien hizo la tierra con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder, \q quien afirmó el mundo con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} sabiduría, \q y con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} inteligencia extendió los cielos.
es.R: Dios hizo la tierra con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder. \q Afirmó el mundo con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} sabiduría. \q Usó {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} inteligencia para extender el cielo.

fr.L: [Il a] fait la terre par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance, \q affermi le monde par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sagesse, \q et par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} intelligence {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a déployé les cieux.
fr.B: C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui a fait la terre par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance, \q qui a établi le monde par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sagesse, \q et qui, par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} intelligence, a déployé les cieux.
fr.R: Dieu a fait la terre par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance. \q Il a solidement établi le monde par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sagesse. \q Il s’est servi de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} intelligence pour déployer le ciel.

sw.L: [Yeye ndiye] aliyeiumba dunia kwa uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q aliyeuthibitisha ulimwengu kwa hekima {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \q na kwa ufahamu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} alizitandaza mbingu.
sw.B: Ni {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} aliyeiumba dunia kwa uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q aliyeuweka ulimwengu imara kwa hekima {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \q na kwa ufahamu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} akazitandaza mbingu.
sw.R: Mungu aliiumba dunia kwa uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. \q Aliuweka ulimwengu imara mahali pake kwa hekima {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. \q Alitumia ufahamu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kulitandaza anga.

vi.L: [Ngài là] Đấng đã làm nên đất bởi quyền năng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q đã lập thế gian bởi sự khôn ngoan {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và bởi sự thông sáng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giương các tầng trời ra.
vi.B: Chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dựng nên đất bởi quyền năng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q đã lập thế giới vững bền bởi sự khôn ngoan {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và giương các tầng trời ra bởi sự thông sáng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời đã dựng nên đất bởi quyền năng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Ngài đặt thế giới vững vàng bởi sự khôn ngoan {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Ngài dùng sự thông sáng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà giăng bầu trời ra.

ko.L: 그분은 자기 능력으로 땅을 만드시고, \q 자기 지혜로 세상을 세우시고, \q 자기 명철로 하늘을 펼치신 분이시다.
ko.B: 바로 그분이 그분의 능력으로 땅을 만드셨고, \q 그분의 지혜로 세상을 굳게 세우셨으며, \q 그분의 명철로 하늘을 펼치셨다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 그분의 능력으로 땅을 만드셨다. \q 그분은 그분의 지혜로 세상을 든든히 세우셨다. \q 그분은 그분의 깨달음으로 하늘을 펼치셨다.

pt.L: [Ele é] o que fez a terra com o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} poder, \q que firmou o mundo com a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} sabedoria, \q e com o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} entendimento estendeu os céus.
pt.B: Foi {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} quem fez a terra com o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} poder, \q quem firmou o mundo com a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} sabedoria \q e com o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} entendimento estendeu os céus.
pt.R: Deus fez a terra com o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} poder. \q Firmou o mundo no lugar com a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} sabedoria. \q Usou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} entendimento para estender o céu.

am.L: ምድርን በኃይሉ የሠራ [እርሱ ነው]፤ \q ዓለምንም በጥበቡ የመሠረተ [እርሱ ነው]፤ \q በማስተዋሉም ሰማያትን ዘረጋ።
am.B: ምድርን በኃይሉ የሠራ እርሱ ነው፤ \q ዓለምን በጥበቡ ያጸና፣ \q በማስተዋሉም ሰማያትን የዘረጋ እርሱ ነው።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ምድርን በኃይሉ ሠራ። \q ዓለምን በጥበቡ አጽንቶ አቆመ። \q በማስተዋሉ ሰማይን ዘረጋ።

hi.L: [वे] अपने सामर्थ्य से पृथ्वी के बनानेवाले [हैं], \q जिन्होंने अपनी बुद्धि से जगत को स्थिर किया, \q और अपनी समझ से आकाश को ताना।
hi.B: उन्हीं ने अपने सामर्थ्य से पृथ्वी को बनाया, \q अपनी बुद्धि से जगत को दृढ़ किया, \q और अपनी समझ से आकाश को फैलाया।
hi.R: परमेश्वर ने अपनी शक्ति से पृथ्वी को बनाया। \q उन्होंने अपनी बुद्धि से संसार को मज़बूती से टिकाया। \q उन्होंने अपनी समझ से आकाश को फैलाया।

ru.L: [Он —] сотворивший землю силой своей, \q утвердивший вселенную мудростью своей, \q и разумом своим {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} распростёр небеса.
ru.B: Это {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сотворил землю своей силой, \q утвердил вселенную своей мудростью \q и своим разумом распростёр небеса.
ru.R: Бог сотворил землю своей силой. \q Он своей мудростью прочно поставил мир на место. \q Своим разумом {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} раскинул небо.

ja.L: [その方は]力によって地を造り、 \q 知恵によって世界を堅く据え、 \q 英知によって天を広げられた。
ja.B: その方こそ、力によって地を造り、 \q 知恵によって世界を堅く据え、 \q 英知によって天を広げられた方である。
ja.R: 神は、その力で地を造られた。 \q その知恵で、世界をしっかりと据えられた。 \q その深い理解によって、空を広げられた。

decisions.choice: verses 15-19 repeat 10:12-16, here word for word
decisions.reason: The hymn to the LORD as Creator in 10:12-16 returns here almost unchanged, and this verse matches 10:12 exactly. In chapter 10 it sets the living God against idols; here it gives the reason Babylon, with all her gods, cannot stand against him. The wording of 10:12-16 is kept wherever the Hebrew is the same, and each difference is noted.

decisions.choice: maker ... establisher: the LORD described by what he did
decisions.reason: As in 10:12. The verse begins with words describing the LORD who has just sworn by himself (verse 14).

decisions.choice: God
decisions.reason: As in 10:12, Readable names the subject.

decisions.choice: the wording of 10:12-16
decisions.reason: Verses 15-19 repeat 10:12-16, and the Spanish of that passage is reused at each level. The only change is in verse 19, where the Hebrew has no "Israel".

decisions.choice: the Swahili wording of 10:12-16 at each level, reused for 51:15-19
decisions.reason: The hymn to the Creator repeats 10:12-16; the same Swahili lets a reader see it, and only what the Hebrew changes is changed (51:19 has no "Israel").

decisions.choice: the hymn of 10:12-16 repeated in verses 15-19
decisions.reason: Verses 15-19 repeat 10:12-16 almost word for word; the French reuses the wording drafted for 10:12-15 at each level, and in verse 19 changes only what the Hebrew changes (no "Israel" before "the tribe").

decisions.choice: the hymn of verses 15-19
decisions.reason: Verses 15-19 repeat 10:12-16, and the Vietnamese of 10:12-16 is kept word for word at each level (the Hebrew differs only in spelling, and "smith" is the same word, so it stays "thợ kim hoàn"). The one change is in verse 19, where the Hebrew lacks "Israel": the line reads "và [cả] chi tộc" (Literal), "kể cả chi tộc" (Balanced) and "Ngài cũng tạo nên dân" (Readable).

decisions.choice: Verses 15-19 reuse the Korean draft of 10:12-16 at each level, word for word except where the Hebrew differs (verse 19 has no "Israel")
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: verses 15-19 repeat 10:12-16.

decisions.choice: the Portuguese of 10:12-16
decisions.reason: Verses 15-19 repeat 10:12-16 (m1), and keep their Portuguese level by level, as 10:12 asks, changing only where the Hebrew differs (verse 19, without "Israel").

decisions.choice: verses 15-18 copy the Amharic of 10:12-15 level by level; verse 19 copies 10:16 except where the Hebrew lacks "Israel".
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats 10:12-16 word for word (verse 16 with spelling differences only); the English levels are the same too.

decisions.choice: the wording of 10:12 at each level
decisions.reason: Verses 15-19 repeat 10:12-16; the Hebrew of this verse is the same as 10:12, and each level copies its Hindi.

decisions.choice: the same words as 10:12
decisions.reason: Verses 15-19 repeat 10:12-16 (m1). Each level keeps the wording of 10:12-16 where the Hebrew is the same.

decisions.choice: своей, своим without a span
decisions.reason: The English has spans on "his"; Russian "свой" is reflexive and takes no span in this translation.

source.text: לְק֨וֹל תִּתּ֜וֹ הֲמ֥וֹן מַ֨יִם֙ בַּשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַיַּ֥עַל נְשִׂאִ֖ים מִקְצֵה־אָ֑רֶץ בְּרָקִ֤ים לַמָּטָר֙ עָשָׂ֔ה וַיֹּ֥צֵא ר֖וּחַ מֵאֹצְרֹתָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: At [the] sound of his giving, a roar of waters in the heavens, and he makes go up clouds from [the] end of earth; lightnings for the rain he makes, and he brings out wind from his storehouses.

en.L: At the sound of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} giving forth [{{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice], [there is] a roar of waters in the heavens, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} makes clouds rise from the end of the earth; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} makes lightning for the rain \q and brings out wind from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} storehouses.
en.B: When {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} thunders, the waters in the heavens roar; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} raises the clouds from the far edges of the earth. \q He makes lightning flash with the rain \q and brings the wind out of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} storehouses.
en.R: When {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} thunders, the waters in the sky roar. \q He makes clouds rise up from far away at the edge of the world. \q He sends lightning with the rain. \q He brings out the wind from the places where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} keeps it.

es.L: Al sonido de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} [voz], [hay] estruendo de aguas en los cielos, \q y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hace subir las nubes desde el extremo de la tierra; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hace los relámpagos para la lluvia \q y saca el viento de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} depósitos.
es.B: Cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} truena, rugen las aguas en los cielos; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} levanta las nubes desde los confines de la tierra. \q Él hace brillar los relámpagos con la lluvia \q y saca el viento de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} depósitos.
es.R: Cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} truena, rugen las aguas en el cielo. \q Él hace que las nubes suban desde muy lejos, en el borde del mundo. \q Envía los relámpagos con la lluvia. \q Saca el viento de los lugares donde {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo guarda.

fr.L: Au bruit de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} [cri], [il y a] un grondement d’eaux dans les cieux, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait monter les nuées de l’extrémité de la terre ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait les éclairs pour la pluie \q et fait sortir le vent de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} réserves.
fr.B: Quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait entendre le tonnerre, les eaux grondent dans le ciel ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait monter les nuages des extrémités de la terre. \q Il fait jaillir les éclairs avec la pluie \q et fait sortir le vent de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} réserves.
fr.R: Quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait gronder le tonnerre, les eaux du ciel grondent. \q Il fait monter les nuages de très loin, du bout du monde. \q Il envoie les éclairs avec la pluie. \q Il fait sortir le vent des endroits où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le garde.

sw.L: Kwa sauti ya kutoa [sauti] {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, [kuna] ngurumo ya maji mbinguni, \q naye hupandisha mawingu kutoka mwisho wa dunia; \q hufanya umeme kwa ajili ya mvua \q na kutoa upepo kutoka ghala {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}.
sw.B: Anapopiga radi, maji yaliyo mbinguni yananguruma; \q huyainua mawingu kutoka miisho ya dunia. \q Hufanya umeme umulike pamoja na mvua \q na kuutoa upepo katika ghala {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}.
sw.R: Anapopiga radi, maji yaliyo angani yananguruma. \q Huyafanya mawingu yapande kutoka mbali kwenye mwisho wa dunia. \q Hutuma umeme pamoja na mvua. \q Huutoa upepo kutoka mahali anapouhifadhi.

vi.L: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cất [tiếng], nước trên các tầng trời gầm thét, \q Ngài khiến mây bay lên từ tận cùng đất; \q Ngài làm chớp nhoáng cho mưa \q và đem gió ra từ các kho của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phát tiếng sấm, nước trên các tầng trời gầm vang; \q Ngài khiến mây bay lên từ tận cùng đất. \q Ngài làm chớp lóe lên giữa cơn mưa \q và đem gió ra từ các kho của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phát tiếng sấm, nước trên bầu trời gầm vang. \q Ngài khiến mây bay lên từ những nơi xa tận cuối đất. \q Ngài sai chớp đến cùng với mưa. \q Ngài đem gió ra từ những nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cất giữ.

ko.L: 그분이 [소리를] 내시면 하늘에서 물이 요란하게 울리고, \q 그분은 땅 끝에서 구름이 올라오게 하신다. \q 그분은 비를 위하여 번개를 만드시고 \q 그분의 창고에서 바람을 내보내신다.
ko.B: 그분이 천둥소리를 내시면 하늘의 물이 요란하게 울린다. \q 그분은 땅 끝에서 구름을 일으키신다. \q 그분은 비와 함께 번개를 치게 하시고 \q 그분의 창고에서 바람을 내보내신다.
ko.R: 그분이 천둥을 치시면 하늘의 물이 요란한 소리를 낸다. \q 그분은 멀리 세상 끝에서 구름이 올라오게 하신다. \q 그분은 비와 함께 번개를 보내신다. \q 그분은 바람을 간직해 두신 곳에서 바람을 내보내신다.

pt.L: Ao som do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} dar [a voz], [há] um estrondo de águas nos céus, \q e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} faz subir as nuvens desde a extremidade da terra; \q faz relâmpagos para a chuva \q e tira o vento dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} depósitos.
pt.B: Quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} troveja, as águas nos céus rugem; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} faz subir as nuvens dos confins da terra. \q Faz o relâmpago brilhar com a chuva \q e tira o vento dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} depósitos.
pt.R: Quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} troveja, as águas no céu rugem. \q Ele faz as nuvens subirem lá longe, na beira do mundo. \q Ele manda relâmpagos com a chuva. \q Ele tira o vento dos lugares onde {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} o guarda.

am.L: እርሱ [ድምፁን] ሲሰጥ በሰማያት የውኃ ጩኸት [ይሆናል]፤ \q ከምድር ዳርቻ ደመናትን ያወጣል፤ \q ለዝናብ መብረቅን ያደርጋል፤ \q ከመዛግብቱም ነፋስን ያወጣል።
am.B: ሲያንጎደጉድ በሰማያት ያሉ ውኆች ይጮኻሉ፤ \q ከሩቅ የምድር ዳርቻ ደመናትን ያስነሣል። \q ከዝናብ ጋር መብረቅን ያበርቃል፤ \q ከመዛግብቱም ነፋስን ያወጣል።
am.R: ሲያንጎደጉድ በሰማይ ያሉ ውኆች ይጮኻሉ። \q ከዓለም ዳርቻ ከሩቅ ስፍራ ደመናትን ያስነሣል። \q ከዝናብ ጋር መብረቅን ይልካል። \q ነፋስን ከሚያስቀምጥበት ስፍራ ያወጣዋል።

hi.L: उनके [गर्जन] देने के शब्द पर आकाश में जल का कोलाहल [होता है], \q और वे पृथ्वी के छोर से बादल उठाते हैं; \q वे वर्षा के लिए बिजलियाँ बनाते हैं, \q और अपने भंडारों से हवा निकालते हैं।
hi.B: जब वे गरजते हैं, तो आकाश में जल गरज उठता है; \q वे पृथ्वी के दूर-दूर के छोरों से बादल उठाते हैं। \q वे वर्षा के साथ बिजली चमकाते हैं \q और अपने भंडारों से हवा निकाल लाते हैं।
hi.R: जब वे गरजते हैं, तो आकाश का जल गरज उठता है। \q वे दुनिया के दूर के किनारे से बादल उठाते हैं। \q वे वर्षा के साथ बिजली भेजते हैं। \q वे हवा को उन जगहों से निकाल लाते हैं जहाँ वे उसे रखते हैं।

ru.L: Когда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} подаёт [голос], [поднимается] шум вод на небесах, \q и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} поднимает облака от края земли; \q {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} творит молнии для дождя \q и выводит ветер из хранилищ своих.
ru.B: Когда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} гремит, шумят воды на небесах; \q {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} поднимает облака от дальних краёв земли. \q Он заставляет молнии сверкать с дождём \q и выводит ветер из своих хранилищ.
ru.R: Когда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} гремит, шумят воды в небе. \q Он поднимает облака издалека, с края земли. \q Он посылает молнии с дождём. \q Он выводит ветер из мест, где {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} хранит его.

ja.L: その方が声を出されると、天には水のとどろきが起こり、 \q その方は地の果てから雲を上らせ、 \q 雨のために稲妻を造り、 \q ご自分の倉から風を取り出される。
ja.B: その方が雷鳴をとどろかせると、天の水はどよめく。 \q その方は地の果てから雲を立ち上らせ、 \q 雨と共に稲妻をひらめかせ、 \q ご自分の倉から風を吹き出させる。
ja.R: その方が雷を鳴らされると、空の水がとどろく。 \q その方は、遠い地の果てから雲をわき上がらせる。 \q 雨と一緒に稲妻を送り、 \q しまっておいた所から風を吹き出させる。

decisions.choice: as 10:13, with small differences of spelling only
decisions.reason: The verse repeats 10:13. Two verbs are written in shorter forms, and "the earth" lacks the article; none of this changes the sense, so the wording of 10:13 is kept.

decisions.choice: at the sound of his giving: when he thunders
decisions.reason: As in 10:13, to "give one's voice" is to speak out, and of God it means thunder (Psalm 18:14).

decisions.choice: a roar of waters in the heavens: the rain held above the sky
decisions.reason: As in 10:13 (Genesis 1:7; Psalm 148:4). The phrase also answers verse 13: Babylon dwells on many waters, but the LORD rules all the waters above and below.

decisions.choice: When he thunders
decisions.reason: As in 10:13, Balanced and Readable say what "giving his voice" means.

decisions.choice: the wording of 10:13 at each level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew differs from 10:13 only in spelling, and each level copies its Hindi.

decisions.choice: Когда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} гремит
decisions.reason: "At the sound of his giving [his voice]" means when he thunders (m2); Balanced and Readable say so, as the English does.

source.text: נִבְעַ֤ר כָּל־אָדָם֙ מִדַּ֔עַת הֹבִ֥ישׁ כָּל־צֹרֵ֖ף מִפָּ֑סֶל כִּ֛י שֶׁ֥קֶר נִסְכּ֖וֹ וְלֹא־ר֥וּחַ בָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Is stupid every man without knowledge; is put to shame every smith by [the] idol, for a lie [is] his cast image, and no breath [is] in them.

en.L: Every {{gender:human|man}} is stupid, without knowledge; \q every smith is put to shame by [his] idol, \q for his cast image [is] a lie, and [there is] no breath in them.
en.B: Everyone proves senseless and ignorant; \q every goldsmith is shamed by his idol, \q for the images he casts are a fraud, with no breath in them.
en.R: Everyone who makes idols is stupid and knows nothing. \q Every goldsmith will be ashamed of the idol he made. \q His metal statues are fakes, and there is no life in them.

es.L: Todo hombre se embrutece, sin conocimiento; \q todo fundidor es avergonzado por [su] ídolo, \q porque su imagen fundida [es] mentira, y no [hay] aliento en ellas.
es.B: Todos resultan necios e ignorantes; \q todo orfebre queda en vergüenza por su ídolo, \q porque las imágenes que funde son un fraude, sin aliento en ellas.
es.R: Todo el que hace ídolos es tonto y no sabe nada. \q Todo orfebre se avergonzará del ídolo que hizo. \q Sus estatuas de metal son falsas, y no tienen vida.

fr.L: Tout {{gender:être humain|homme}} est stupide, sans connaissance ; \q tout orfèvre a honte de [son] idole, \q car son image de métal [est] mensonge, et il n’y a pas de souffle en elles.
fr.B: Tout le monde se montre stupide et ignorant ; \q tout orfèvre a honte de son idole, \q car les statues qu’il fond ne sont que tromperie, sans souffle en elles.
fr.R: Tous ceux qui fabriquent des idoles sont stupides et ne savent rien. \q Chaque orfèvre aura honte de l’idole qu’il a fabriquée. \q Ses statues de métal sont fausses, et il n’y a pas de vie en elles.

sw.L: Kila mwanadamu ni mjinga, hana maarifa; \q kila mfua chuma ameaibishwa na sanamu [yake], \q kwa maana sanamu yake ya kusubu [ni] uongo, wala hamna pumzi ndani yake.
sw.B: Kila mtu anaonekana mjinga asiye na maarifa; \q kila mfua dhahabu anaaibishwa na sanamu yake, \q kwa maana sanamu anazozisubu ni udanganyifu, hazina pumzi ndani yake.
sw.R: Kila mtu anayetengeneza sanamu ni mjinga, hajui kitu. \q Kila mfua dhahabu ataiona aibu sanamu aliyoitengeneza. \q Sanamu zake za chuma ni za uongo, wala hazina uhai ndani yake.

vi.L: Mọi người đều ngu muội, không hiểu biết; \q mọi thợ kim hoàn đều bị hổ thẹn vì tượng [mình], \q vì tượng đúc của nó [là] giả dối, và chẳng có hơi thở trong chúng.
vi.B: Mọi người đều tỏ ra ngu muội, thiếu hiểu biết; \q mọi thợ kim hoàn đều bị hổ thẹn vì thần tượng mình, \q vì tượng nó đúc ra là đồ giả, chẳng có hơi thở trong đó.
vi.R: Mọi người làm thần tượng đều ngu dại và chẳng biết gì. \q Mọi thợ kim hoàn sẽ hổ thẹn vì thần tượng mình đã làm. \q Tượng kim loại của nó là đồ giả, chẳng có sự sống trong đó.

ko.L: 모든 사람이 어리석어 지식이 없고, \q 금속 장인마다 [자기] 우상 때문에 수치를 당한다. \q 그가 부어 만든 형상은 거짓이요, 그것들 속에는 숨이 없다.
ko.B: 사람마다 어리석고 무지하다. \q 금세공인마다 자기가 만든 우상 때문에 수치를 당한다. \q 그가 부어 만든 형상은 가짜이고 그 속에는 숨이 없다.
ko.R: 우상을 만드는 사람은 모두 어리석고 아무것도 모른다. \q 금세공인마다 자기가 만든 우상 때문에 부끄러움을 당할 것이다. \q 그가 쇠붙이를 부어 만든 형상은 가짜이고, 그 속에는 생명이 없다.

pt.L: Todo {{gender:ser humano|homem}} é estúpido, sem conhecimento; \q todo fundidor é envergonhado pelo [seu] ídolo, \q pois a sua imagem fundida [é] mentira, e não [há] fôlego nelas.
pt.B: Todos se mostram insensatos e ignorantes; \q todo ourives é envergonhado pelo seu ídolo, \q pois as imagens que ele funde são uma fraude, sem fôlego nelas.
pt.R: Todos os que fazem ídolos são estúpidos e não sabem nada. \q Todo ourives vai ficar envergonhado do ídolo que fez. \q As suas estátuas de metal são falsas, e não há vida nelas.

am.L: ሰው ሁሉ ደነዘ፤ እውቀት የለውም፤ \q አንጥረኛ ሁሉ በጣዖቱ ያፍራል፤ \q ቀልጦ የተሠራው ምስሉ ሐሰት ነውና፤ በውስጣቸውም እስትንፋስ የለም።
am.B: ሰው ሁሉ ማስተዋል የጎደለውና አላዋቂ ሆኖ ተገኝቷል፤ \q ወርቅ አንጥረኛ ሁሉ በጣዖቱ ያፍራል፤ \q ቀልጦ የሚሠራው ምስሉ ማታለያ ነውና፤ እስትንፋስም የለበትም።
am.R: ጣዖታትን የሚሠራ ሁሉ ደነዝ ነው፤ ምንም አያውቅም። \q ወርቅ አንጥረኛ ሁሉ በሠራው ጣዖት ያፍራል። \q ከብረት ቀልጠው የተሠሩት ምስሎቹ የውሸት ናቸው፤ ሕይወትም የላቸውም።

hi.L: हर मनुष्य पशु-बुद्धि [है], ज्ञान से रहित; \q हर सुनार [अपनी] मूर्ति के कारण लज्जित होता है, \q क्योंकि उसकी ढाली हुई मूर्ति झूठ [है], और उनमें साँस नहीं।
hi.B: हर कोई नासमझ और अज्ञानी निकलता है; \q हर सुनार अपनी मूर्ति के कारण लज्जित होता है, \q क्योंकि जो मूर्तियाँ वह ढालता है वे धोखा हैं, उनमें साँस नहीं।
hi.R: मूर्तियाँ बनानेवाला हर व्यक्ति मूर्ख है और कुछ नहीं जानता। \q हर सुनार अपनी बनाई हुई मूर्ति के कारण लज्जित होगा। \q उसकी धातु की मूर्तियाँ नक़ली हैं, और उनमें कोई जीवन नहीं।

ru.L: Туп всякий человек, без знания; \q посрамлён всякий плавильщик [своим] идолом, \q потому что ложь — его литой истукан, и нет в них дыхания.
ru.B: Каждый оказывается бессмысленным и невежественным; \q каждый золотых дел мастер посрамлён своим идолом, \q потому что его литые изваяния — обман, и нет в них дыхания.
ru.R: Каждый, кто делает идолов, глуп и ничего не знает. \q Каждому золотых дел мастеру будет стыдно за идола, которого он сделал. \q Его металлические статуи — подделка, и в них нет жизни.

ja.L: すべての人は愚かで、知識がない。 \q すべての金細工人は、自分の偶像のために恥を見る。 \q その鋳た像は偽りで、それらの中には息がないからだ。
ja.B: 人はみな愚かで無知である。 \q 金細工人はみな、自分の造った偶像のために恥を受ける。 \q 彼の鋳た像は偽物で、その中には息がない。
ja.R: 偶像を造る者はみな、愚かで何も知らない。 \q 金細工人はみな、自分が造った偶像のことで恥をかく。 \q その金属の像は偽物で、その中には命がない。

decisions.choice: as 10:14, with one word spelled differently
decisions.reason: The verse repeats 10:14; "smith" is spelled without one letter, with no change of sense. The wording of 10:14 is kept. In this chapter the idols are Babylon's own (verses 44, 47, 52).

decisions.choice: every human is stupid, without knowledge: people shown up as senseless
decisions.reason: As in 10:14. Beside the wisdom of God who made the world (verse 15), those who trust in idols are shown to know nothing.

decisions.choice: a lie ... no breath: a false god with no life
decisions.reason: As in 10:14. The image pretends to be a god and has no breath of life.

decisions.choice: Everyone who makes idols
decisions.reason: As in 10:14, Readable narrows "every person" to those who make idols. It is a stretch from the general words, which could also mean that every person is senseless beside God's wisdom.

decisions.choice: "kila mwanadamu" with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in the English
decisions.reason: "Mwanadamu" already means any human being; Swahili has no second wording for the setting.

decisions.choice: mọi người
decisions.reason: "Every man" means every human being; Vietnamese "người" covers all, so no gender span is needed where the English has one.

decisions.choice: No gender span on "ሰው ሁሉ", as 10:14.
decisions.reason: ሰው already means any human being.

decisions.choice: the wording of 10:14 at each level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew differs from 10:14 in one spelling only, and each level copies its Hindi.

decisions.choice: "हर मनुष्य" without a gender span
decisions.reason: As 10:14: "मनुष्य" already includes men and women, so the English span on "human / man" has no Hindi counterpart.

decisions.choice: человек, no gender span
decisions.reason: The English has a gender span on "human / man"; Russian "человек" already means any human being.

decisions.choice: kol 'adam "すべての人" with no gender span, as 10:14.
decisions.reason: 人 is inclusive.

source.text: הֶ֣בֶל הֵ֔מָּה מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה תַּעְתֻּעִ֑ים בְּעֵ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֖ם יֹאבֵֽדוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Futility [are] they, a work of mockeries; at [the] time of their punishment they will perish.

en.L: They [are] futility, a work of mockery; \q at the time of their punishment they will perish.
en.B: They are empty breath, a work to be laughed at; \q when the time comes to punish them, they will perish.
en.R: Idols are worthless, something to laugh at. \q When God comes to punish them, they will be destroyed.

es.L: Vanidad [son], obra de burla; \q en el tiempo de su castigo perecerán.
es.B: Son un soplo vacío, una obra para burlarse de ella; \q cuando llegue el tiempo de castigarlos, perecerán.
es.R: Los ídolos no valen nada; son algo de lo que reírse. \q Cuando Dios venga a castigarlos, serán destruidos.

fr.L: Elles [sont] vanité, une œuvre de moquerie ; \q au temps de leur châtiment, elles périront.
fr.B: Elles ne sont que vent, une œuvre ridicule ; \q quand viendra le temps de les punir, elles périront.
fr.R: Les idoles ne valent rien, on peut seulement se moquer d’elles. \q Quand Dieu viendra les punir, elles seront détruites.

sw.L: Hizo [ni] ubatili, kazi ya mizaha; \q wakati wa kuadhibiwa kwao zitaangamia.
sw.B: Hizo ni pumzi tupu, kazi ya kuchekwa; \q wakati utakapofika wa kuziadhibu, zitaangamia.
sw.R: Sanamu hazifai kitu; ni kitu cha kuchekwa. \q Mungu atakapokuja kuziadhibu, zitaangamizwa.

vi.L: Chúng [là] hư không, là công việc đáng chế giễu; \q vào lúc chúng bị trừng phạt, chúng sẽ bị diệt.
vi.B: Chúng chỉ là hơi thở hư không, một thứ đáng chế giễu; \q khi đến lúc chúng bị trừng phạt, chúng sẽ bị tiêu diệt.
vi.R: Thần tượng thật vô giá trị, chỉ đáng để người ta chê cười. \q Khi Đức Chúa Trời đến trừng phạt chúng, chúng sẽ bị hủy diệt.

ko.L: 그것들은 헛된 것이요, 조롱거리의 작품이다. \q 그것들이 벌받는 때에 멸망할 것이다.
ko.B: 그것들은 헛된 입김이요, 비웃음거리가 될 물건이다. \q 그것들을 벌하실 때가 오면 그것들은 망할 것이다.
ko.R: 우상들은 쓸모없고 웃음거리일 뿐이다. \q 하나님께서 그것들을 벌하러 오시면 그것들은 멸망할 것이다.

pt.L: Sopro [são] eles, obra de zombaria; \q no tempo do seu castigo perecerão.
pt.B: São um sopro vazio, uma obra ridícula; \q quando chegar o tempo de castigá-los, perecerão.
pt.R: Os ídolos não valem nada, são coisas de dar risada. \q Quando Deus vier castigá-los, eles vão ser destruídos.

am.L: እነርሱ ከንቱ፣ የመሳለቂያ ሥራ ናቸው፤ \q በሚቀጡበት ጊዜ ይጠፋሉ።
am.B: ባዶ እስትንፋስ፣ መሳቂያ ሥራ ናቸው፤ \q የሚቀጡበት ጊዜ ሲደርስ ይጠፋሉ።
am.R: ጣዖታት ዋጋ ቢሶች፣ መሳቂያዎችም ናቸው። \q እግዚአብሔር ሊቀጣቸው በሚመጣበት ጊዜ ይጠፋሉ።

hi.L: वे साँस मात्र [हैं], ठट्ठे का काम; \q अपने दंड के समय वे नाश हो जाएँगी।
hi.B: वे खोखली साँस हैं, हँसी के योग्य काम; \q जब उन्हें दंड देने का समय आएगा, वे नाश हो जाएँगी।
hi.R: मूर्तियाँ बेकार हैं, हँसी उड़ाने लायक़ चीज़ें। \q जब परमेश्वर उन्हें दंड देने आएँगे, तब वे नष्ट हो जाएँगी।

ru.L: Они — дуновение, дело насмешки; \q во время их наказания они погибнут.
ru.B: Они — пустое дуновение, изделие, достойное насмешки; \q когда придёт время их наказать, они погибнут.
ru.R: Идолы ничего не стоят, над ними можно только посмеяться. \q Когда Бог придёт наказать их, они будут уничтожены.

ja.L: それらは空しいもの、物笑いの種となる作り物。 \q 罰の時に、それらは滅びる。
ja.B: それらは空しい息、あざけりを受ける作り物にすぎない。 \q 罰を受ける時が来ると、それらは滅びる。
ja.R: 偶像は役に立たない。笑いものにすぎない。 \q 神が罰を下される時、それらは滅ぼされる。

decisions.choice: the same as 10:15
decisions.reason: The Hebrew matches 10:15 exactly, and its wording is kept.

decisions.choice: futility ... a work of mockery
decisions.reason: As in 10:15: the idols are empty breath, things that deceive and deserve to be laughed at. The word for "mockery" appears only here and in 10:15.

decisions.choice: the time of their punishment: when God comes to deal with them
decisions.reason: As in 10:15. Verses 44, 47 and 52 say when that time comes for Babylon's idols.

decisions.choice: Idols ... God comes
decisions.reason: As in 10:15.

decisions.choice: the wording of 10:15 at each level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is the same as 10:15, and each level copies its Hindi.

decisions.choice: дуновение (L); пустое дуновение (B)
decisions.reason: The word hevel, "breath", used of idols; Literal and Balanced keep the image of breath, as the poetry note has hevel and as 10:15, which this verse repeats.

source.text: לֹֽא־כְאֵ֜לֶּה חֵ֣לֶק יַעֲק֗וֹב כִּֽי־יוֹצֵ֤ר הַכֹּל֙ ה֔וּא וְשֵׁ֖בֶט נַחֲלָת֑וֹ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Not like these [is the] portion of Jacob, for [the] former of the all he [is], and [the] tribe of his inheritance; Yahweh of hosts [is] his name.

en.L: Not like these [is] the portion of Jacob, for the one who formed all things [is] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}, \q and [also] the tribe of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} inheritance; \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts [is] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name.
en.B: The God who is Jacob's portion is not like these, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is the one who formed all things, \q including the tribe {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} holds as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own; \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name.
en.R: But the God who belongs to Jacob's people is not like these idols, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made everything there is. \q He also made the people {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} chose to be {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} very own. \q His name is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.

es.L: No es como estos la porción de Jacob, porque el Formador de todo [es] {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, \q y [también] la tribu de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} heredad; \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos [es] {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre.
es.B: El Dios que es la porción de Jacob no es como estos, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es quien formó todas las cosas, \q incluida la tribu que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} tiene como {{deity_pronoun:suya|Suya}}; \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre.
es.R: Pero el Dios del pueblo de Jacob no es como esos ídolos, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hizo todo lo que existe. \q También formó a la tribu que es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo propio. \q Su nombre es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.

fr.L: Celui qui est la part de Jacob n’[est] pas comme elles, car c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui a formé toutes choses, \q et [aussi] la tribu de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} héritage ; \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées [est] {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom.
fr.B: Le Dieu qui est la part de Jacob n’est pas comme elles, car c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui a formé toutes choses, \q y compris la tribu qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} possède comme {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} bien ; \q {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.R: Mais le Dieu qui appartient au peuple de Jacob n’est pas comme ces idoles, car c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui a fait tout ce qui existe. \q Il a fait aussi le peuple qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a choisi pour en faire {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} bien. \q Son nom est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.

sw.L: Fungu la Yakobo si kama hizo, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} [ndiye] aliyeviumba vitu vyote, \q na [pia] kabila la urithi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi [ndilo] jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.
sw.B: Mungu aliye fungu la Yakobo si kama hizo, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ndiye aliyeviumba vitu vyote, \q pamoja na kabila analolishika kuwa mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}; \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi ndilo jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.
sw.R: Lakini Mungu wa watu wa Yakobo si kama sanamu hizo, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ndiye aliyeumba kila kitu kilichopo. \q Pia aliwaumba watu aliowachagua kuwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} hasa. \q Jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.

vi.L: Phần của Gia-cốp không như những thứ này, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] Đấng đã tạo nên muôn vật, \q và [cả] chi tộc thuộc cơ nghiệp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân [là] danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Đức Chúa Trời là phần của Gia-cốp không giống như những thứ ấy, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đấng tạo nên muôn vật, \q kể cả chi tộc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giữ làm cơ nghiệp riêng; \q danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân.
vi.R: Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời của dân Gia-cốp không giống như các thần tượng ấy, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã tạo nên muôn vật. \q Ngài cũng tạo nên dân mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn làm dân riêng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân.

ko.L: 야곱의 몫은 이런 것들과 같지 않다. 그분은 만물을 지으신 분이시고, \q [또한] 그분의 유업인 지파[를 지으셨다]. \q 그분의 이름은 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시다.
ko.B: 야곱의 몫이신 하나님은 이런 것들과 같지 않으시다. 그분은 만물을 지으신 분이시고, \q 그분이 자기 것으로 삼으신 지파도 지으셨다. \q 그분의 이름은 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시다.
ko.R: 그러나 야곱 백성의 하나님은 이런 우상들과 같지 않으시다. 그분은 세상의 모든 것을 만드셨다. \q 그분은 그분이 골라 그분의 백성으로 삼으신 사람들도 만드셨다. \q 그분의 이름은 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시다.

pt.L: Não [é] como estes a porção de Jacó, pois o formador de todas as coisas [é] {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, \q e [também] a tribo da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} herança; \q {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos [é] o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome.
pt.B: O Deus que é a porção de Jacó não é como estes, pois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é quem formou todas as coisas, \q inclusive a tribo que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tem como {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} propriedade; \q {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos é o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome.
pt.R: Mas o Deus que pertence ao povo de Jacó não é como esses ídolos, pois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez tudo o que existe. \q Ele também fez o povo que escolheu para ser o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} próprio povo. \q O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome é {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.

am.L: የያዕቆብ ድርሻ እንደ እነዚህ አይደለም፤ ሁሉን የፈጠረ እርሱ ነውና፤ \q የርስቱንም ነገድ [ደግሞ]፤ \q ስሙ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት [ነው]።
am.B: የያዕቆብ ድርሻ የሆነው አምላክ እንደ እነዚህ አይደለም፤ ሁሉን የፈጠረ እርሱ ነውና፤ \q የገዛ ርስቱ አድርጎ የያዘውን ነገድ ጭምር፤ \q ስሙ የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነው።
am.R: የያዕቆብ ሕዝብ አምላክ ግን እንደ እነዚህ ጣዖታት አይደለም፤ ያለውን ሁሉ የፈጠረ እርሱ ነውና። \q የራሱ እንዲሆኑ የመረጣቸውንም ሕዝብ ሠራ። \q ስሙ የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነው።

hi.L: याकूब का भाग इनके समान नहीं, क्योंकि सब वस्तुओं के रचनेवाले वही [हैं], \q और उनके निज भाग के गोत्र के [भी]; \q सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उनका नाम [है]।
hi.B: जो परमेश्वर याकूब का भाग हैं, वे इनके समान नहीं, क्योंकि वे ही सब वस्तुओं के रचनेवाले हैं, \q उस गोत्र के भी जिसे उन्होंने अपना निज भाग बनाया है; \q सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उनका नाम है।
hi.R: पर याकूब के लोगों के परमेश्वर इन मूर्तियों जैसे नहीं हैं, क्योंकि उन्होंने ही सब कुछ बनाया है। \q उन्होंने उन लोगों को भी बनाया जिन्हें उन्होंने अपनी निज प्रजा होने के लिए चुना। \q उनका नाम सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} है।

ru.L: Не таков, как они, удел Иакова, потому что Создатель всего — {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}}, \q и [также] колена {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} наследия; \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф — {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя.
ru.B: Бог, который — удел Иакова, не таков, как они, ведь {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} создал всё, \q в том числе и колено, которое {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} держит как своё владение; \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф — {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя.
ru.R: Но Бог, который принадлежит народу Иакова, не похож на этих идолов, ведь {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сотворил всё, что есть. \q Он создал и народ, который {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} избрал, чтобы тот был {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} собственным. \q Его имя — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств.

ja.L: ヤコブの分け前はこれらのようではない。その方は万物を形づくられた方であり、 \q その方の嗣業の部族も[形づくられた]。 \q 万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がその名である。
ja.B: ヤコブの分け前である神は、これらのようではない。その方は万物を形づくられた方、 \q ご自分のものとされた部族をも形づくられた方である。 \q その名は万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}。
ja.R: しかし、ヤコブの民の神は、これらの偶像とは違う。その方は、すべてのものを造られた。 \q その方は、ご自分の民として選ばれた人々も造られた。 \q その方の名は、天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}だ。

decisions.choice: as 10:16, but without the word "Israel"
alternatives: and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance, with Israel understood from 10:16
decisions.reason: In 10:16 the line reads "and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance". Here "Israel" is lacking, and the line joins on to what comes before: the LORD formed all things, and the tribe he holds as his own among them. It may also be read with "Israel" understood from 10:16; the sense is close either way. "Jacob" is also spelled more fully here. Otherwise the wording of 10:16 is kept.

decisions.choice: the portion of Jacob: God himself is the share that belongs to his people
decisions.reason: As in 10:16 (Deuteronomy 32:9; Psalm 16:5; Lamentations 3:24).

decisions.choice: the tribe of his inheritance: the people God holds as his own
decisions.reason: As in 10:16 (Psalm 74:2). After the hymn, the poem turns back to Babylon (verse 20).

decisions.choice: [also] (L); including (B); He also made (R)
decisions.reason: Without "Israel", the line is joined to "the one who formed all things" (m1). Literal brackets the joining word; Balanced and Readable say "including" and "also". Balanced and Readable keep the rest of the wording of 10:16, with "Armies" for "hosts".

decisions.choice: y [también] la tribu (L); incluida la tribu (B); También escogió a su pueblo (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of 10:16 is kept, except that the Hebrew here has no "Israel" before "the tribe of his inheritance".

decisions.choice: "Celui qui est la part de Jacob"
alternatives: "La part de Jacob n’est pas comme elles"
decisions.reason: French "part" is feminine and would be read as one of the idols; Literal names the portion as a person, as the next clause does.

decisions.choice: "[또한] 그분의 유업인 지파[를 지으셨다]" (L); "지파도 지으셨다" (B); "사람들도 만드셨다" (R)
decisions.reason: 10:16 names Israel; here the Hebrew does not, so the tribe is read with "formed", as the English supplies "also".

decisions.choice: [também] (L); inclusive (B); Ele também fez (R)
decisions.reason: The verse is 10:16 without "Israel" (m1), so it keeps 10:16's Portuguese and changes only that line, as the English does.

decisions.choice: the wording of 10:16, with the second line changed: "የርስቱንም ነገድ [ደግሞ]" (Literal), "... ነገድ ጭምር" (Balanced), "... ሕዝብ ሠራ" (Readable).
decisions.reason: Here the Hebrew lacks "Israel", so the tribe is part of "all things" he formed, as the English levels read.

decisions.choice: the wording of 10:16 at each level, without "इस्राएल"
alternatives: "और इस्राएल उनके निज भाग का गोत्र है"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is 10:16 without the word "Israel"; each level copies the Hindi of 10:16 and joins the second line to "the one who formed all things", as the English does, Literal bracketing "[भी]".

decisions.choice: [также] (L); в том числе (B); создал и (R)
decisions.reason: Without "Israel", which 10:16 has, the line is joined to "the one who formed all things" (m1), as the English does at each level.

decisions.choice: колено
decisions.reason: The tribe keeps the Pentateuch note's "колено" at Literal and Balanced; Readable says "народ", as the English says "the people".

decisions.choice: JER 10:16 copied, without "Israel" in the second line, as the Hebrew here: "その方の嗣業の部族も" (L), "ご自分のものとされた部族をも" (B), "ご自分の民として選ばれた人々も" (R).
decisions.reason: m1: the one difference from 10:16.

source.text: מַפֵּץ־אַתָּ֣ה לִ֔י כְּלֵ֖י מִלְחָמָ֑ה וְנִפַּצְתִּ֤י בְךָ֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם וְהִשְׁחַתִּ֥י בְךָ֖ מַמְלָכֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: A war club [are] you to me, weapons of war; and I shatter with you nations, and I destroy with you kingdoms.

en.L: You [are] my war club, [my] weapon of war; \q and with you I shatter nations, \q and with you I destroy kingdoms.
en.B: You are my war club, my weapon of war: \q with you I shatter nations; \q with you I destroy kingdoms.
en.R: You are my war club, the weapon I use in battle. \q With you I smash nations. \q With you I destroy kingdoms.

es.L: Martillo [eres] tú para mí, arma de guerra; \q contigo quebranto naciones, \q y contigo destruyo reinos.
es.B: Tú eres mi mazo de guerra, mi arma para la batalla: \q contigo quebranto naciones, \q contigo destruyo reinos.
es.R: Tú eres mi mazo de guerra, el arma que uso en la batalla. \q Contigo hago pedazos a las naciones. \q Contigo destruyo reinos.

fr.L: Tu [es] ma massue, [mon] arme de guerre ; \q et par toi je brise des nations, \q et par toi je détruis des royaumes.
fr.B: Tu es ma massue, mon arme de guerre : \q par toi je brise les nations ; \q par toi je détruis les royaumes.
fr.R: Tu es ma massue, l’arme dont je me sers pour la bataille. \q Avec toi, j’écrase les nations. \q Avec toi, je détruis les royaumes.

sw.L: Wewe [ni] rungu langu la vita, [silaha yangu] ya vita; \q nami kwa wewe ninavunjavunja mataifa, \q na kwa wewe ninaangamiza falme.
sw.B: Wewe ni rungu langu la vita, silaha yangu ya vita: \q kwa wewe ninavunjavunja mataifa; \q kwa wewe ninaangamiza falme.
sw.R: Wewe ni rungu langu la vita, silaha ninayoitumia vitani. \q Kwa wewe ninayaponda mataifa. \q Kwa wewe ninaziangamiza falme.

vi.L: Ngươi [là] cây chùy của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, khí giới chiến trận [của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}]; \q với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đập tan các dân tộc, \q với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hủy diệt các vương quốc.
vi.B: Ngươi là cây chùy của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, là khí giới chiến trận của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}: \q với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đập tan các dân tộc; \q với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hủy diệt các vương quốc.
vi.R: Ngươi là cây chùy chiến của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, là vũ khí {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} dùng trong trận chiến. \q Với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đập nát các dân tộc. \q Với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hủy diệt các vương quốc.

ko.L: 너는 나의 철퇴, [나의] 전쟁 무기다. \q 내가 너로 민족들을 부수고, \q 내가 너로 왕국들을 멸망시킨다.
ko.B: 너는 나의 철퇴, 나의 전쟁 무기다. \q 내가 너로 민족들을 부수고, \q 내가 너로 왕국들을 멸망시킨다.
ko.R: 너는 나의 쇠몽둥이, 내가 전쟁에서 쓰는 무기다. \q 내가 너로 민족들을 부순다. \q 내가 너로 왕국들을 멸망시킨다.

pt.L: Tu [és] o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} martelo de guerra, [a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}}] arma de guerra; \q e contigo despedaço nações, \q e contigo destruo reinos.
pt.B: Tu és o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} martelo de guerra, a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} arma de guerra: \q contigo despedaço nações; \q contigo destruo reinos.
pt.R: Tu és o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} martelo de guerra, a arma que uso na batalha. \q Contigo esmago nações. \q Contigo destruo reinos.

am.L: አንተ የጦር ዱላዬ፣ የሰልፍ መሣሪያ[ዬ] ነህ፤ \q በአንተም ሕዝቦችን እሰባብራለሁ፤ \q በአንተም መንግሥታትን አጠፋለሁ።
am.B: አንተ የጦር ዱላዬ፣ የሰልፍ መሣሪያዬ ነህ፤ \q በአንተ ሕዝቦችን እሰባብራለሁ፤ \q በአንተ መንግሥታትን አጠፋለሁ።
am.R: አንተ የጦር ዱላዬ፣ በውጊያ የምጠቀምብህ መሣሪያዬ ነህ። \q በአንተ ሕዝቦችን እሰባብራለሁ። \q በአንተ መንግሥታትን አጠፋለሁ።

hi.L: तुम मेरी गदा [हो], [मेरे] युद्ध के हथियार; \q और तुमसे मैं जातियों को चूर-चूर करता हूँ, \q और तुमसे मैं राज्यों को नाश करता हूँ।
hi.B: तुम मेरी गदा हो, मेरे युद्ध के हथियार: \q तुमसे मैं देशों को चूर-चूर करता हूँ; \q तुमसे मैं राज्यों को नाश करता हूँ।
hi.R: तुम मेरी गदा हो, वह हथियार जिसे मैं युद्ध में चलाता हूँ। \q तुमसे मैं देशों को कुचल डालता हूँ। \q तुमसे मैं राज्यों को नाश करता हूँ।

ru.L: Молот ты для {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, оружие войны; \q и тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сокрушаю народы, \q и тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} истребляю царства.
ru.B: Ты — {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} боевой молот, {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} оружие войны: \q тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сокрушаю народы, \q тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} истребляю царства.
ru.R: Ты — {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} боевой молот, оружие, которым {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сражаюсь. \q Тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} разбиваю народы. \q Тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} истребляю царства.

ja.L: おまえはわたしの打ち砕くこん棒、戦いの武器だ。 \q わたしはおまえで国々を打ち砕き、 \q おまえで王国を滅ぼす。
ja.B: おまえはわたしの戦いのこん棒、戦いの武器だ。 \q わたしはおまえで国々を打ち砕き、 \q おまえで王国を滅ぼす。
ja.R: おまえは、わたしが戦いに使うこん棒、わたしの武器だ。 \q わたしはおまえで国々を打ち砕く。 \q おまえで王国を滅ぼす。

decisions.choice: war club ... I shatter: a play on one root
decisions.reason: The word *mappets* means a club or hammer for smashing, from the root of the verb "shatter" that follows nine times in verses 20-23; the tenth verb is "destroy". The repetition is the point: whatever the club strikes is broken. Babylon was called "the hammer of the whole earth" in 50:23, with a different word.

decisions.choice: you: most likely Babylon, the LORD's weapon against the nations
alternatives: the conqueror who will destroy Babylon
decisions.reason: The poem does not name the "you". Babylon fits best: God used her to break the nations (25:9; 27:6; 50:23), and verse 24 turns to repay her. Others read "you" as the coming conqueror, Cyrus, or as Israel, through whom God will break Babylon. The verbs can describe what God has done again and again or what he will do; the present tense keeps both open.

decisions.choice: with you I shatter (L, B); With you I smash (R): the same words each time
decisions.reason: The phrase is kept the same through all ten lines of verses 20-23 at each level, so that the hammer blows can be heard. Literal supplies "[my]".

decisions.choice: contigo quebranto (L, B); Contigo hago pedazos (R)
decisions.reason: The same words open each line of verses 20-23, as in the Hebrew; every level keeps the repetition.

decisions.choice: "kwa wewe ninavunjavunja" (L, B), "Kwa wewe ninaponda" (R), the same words in each line of verses 20-23
decisions.reason: The repeated phrase is the shape of the poem, so each level keeps one wording for it throughout.

decisions.choice: "par toi je brise" (L, B); "Avec toi, j’écrase" (R), repeated the same way in verses 20-23
decisions.reason: The repeated phrase is kept unchanged each time, as in the Hebrew and the English.

decisions.choice: với ngươi Ta đập tan (L, B); Với ngươi Ta đập nát (R), the same words each time
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats one verb nine times in verses 20-23; Vietnamese keeps the same words in every line, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "내가 너로 ... 부수고" repeated in the same words through verses 20-23
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats one verb (a play on "war club"); Korean keeps the refrain by repeating "부수다" each time.

decisions.choice: martelo de guerra; despedaço (L, B), esmago (R)
decisions.reason: The war club and the verb share one root (m1); Portuguese keeps one verb through verses 20-23, as the English does, and "martelo de guerra" for the club, which also calls up "o martelo de toda a terra" of 50:23.

decisions.choice: "with you I shatter" is "በአንተ(ም) ... እሰባብራለሁ" at every level, every time through verse 23.
decisions.reason: The Hebrew hammers one verb nine times; the repetition is the point.

decisions.choice: "तुमसे मैं ... चूर-चूर करता हूँ" (L, B); "तुमसे मैं ... कुचल डालता हूँ" (R), the same in each line of verses 20-23
decisions.reason: The phrase is repeated through all the lines of verses 20-23 at each level, so the hammer blows can be heard, as the English does.

decisions.choice: тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сокрушаю (L, B); Тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} разбиваю (R)
decisions.reason: "War club" and "shatter" share one root (m1); the phrase is kept the same through all ten lines of verses 20-23 at each level, as the English does, so that the blows can be heard.

decisions.choice: mappets / nippatsti: "打ち砕くこん棒" (L), "こん棒" (B, R) with the verb "打ち砕く" repeated through 51:20-23, so the one root is heard; "you" (most likely Babylon) "おまえ".
