decisions.reason: m1: the play on one root; m2 the addressee is uncertain and footnoted.

source.text: וְנִפַּצְתִּ֣י בְךָ֔ ס֖וּס וְרֹֽכְב֑וֹ וְנִפַּצְתִּ֣י בְךָ֔ רֶ֖כֶב וְרֹכְבֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I shatter with you horse and its rider, and I shatter with you chariot and its rider.

en.L: and with you I shatter horse and its rider, \q and with you I shatter chariot and its rider;
en.B: with you I shatter horse and rider; \q with you I shatter chariot and driver;
en.R: With you I smash horses and their riders. \q With you I smash chariots and their drivers.

es.L: y contigo quebranto caballo y jinete, \q y contigo quebranto carro y auriga;
es.B: contigo quebranto caballo y jinete; \q contigo quebranto carro y conductor;
es.R: Contigo hago pedazos a los caballos y a sus jinetes. \q Contigo hago pedazos a los carros y a sus conductores.

fr.L: et par toi je brise le cheval et son cavalier, \q et par toi je brise le char et celui qui le monte ;
fr.B: par toi je brise cheval et cavalier ; \q par toi je brise char et conducteur ;
fr.R: Avec toi, j’écrase les chevaux et leurs cavaliers. \q Avec toi, j’écrase les chars et leurs conducteurs.

sw.L: na kwa wewe ninavunjavunja farasi na mpanda farasi wake, \q na kwa wewe ninavunjavunja gari la vita na mwendeshaji wake;
sw.B: kwa wewe ninavunjavunja farasi na mpanda farasi; \q kwa wewe ninavunjavunja gari la vita na dereva wake;
sw.R: Kwa wewe ninawaponda farasi na wapanda farasi wao. \q Kwa wewe ninayaponda magari ya vita na madereva wake.

vi.L: với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đập tan ngựa và người cưỡi, \q với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đập tan xe chiến và người đánh xe;
vi.B: với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đập tan ngựa và người cưỡi; \q với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đập tan xe chiến và người đánh xe;
vi.R: Với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đập nát ngựa và người cưỡi ngựa. \q Với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đập nát xe chiến và người đánh xe.

ko.L: 내가 너로 말과 그 탄 자를 부수고, \q 내가 너로 병거와 그 탄 자를 부순다.
ko.B: 내가 너로 말과 기병을 부수고, \q 내가 너로 병거와 병거를 모는 자를 부순다.
ko.R: 내가 너로 말들과 그 말을 탄 사람들을 부순다. \q 내가 너로 병거들과 그 병거를 모는 사람들을 부순다.

pt.L: e contigo despedaço o cavalo e o seu cavaleiro, \q e contigo despedaço o carro e o seu condutor;
pt.B: contigo despedaço cavalo e cavaleiro; \q contigo despedaço carro e condutor;
pt.R: Contigo esmago os cavalos e os seus cavaleiros. \q Contigo esmago os carros e os seus condutores.

am.L: በአንተም ፈረስንና ጋላቢውን እሰባብራለሁ፤ \q በአንተም ሰረገላንና ነጂውን እሰባብራለሁ፤
am.B: በአንተ ፈረስንና ጋላቢውን እሰባብራለሁ፤ \q በአንተ ሰረገላንና ነጂውን እሰባብራለሁ፤
am.R: በአንተ ፈረሶችንና ጋላቢዎቻቸውን እሰባብራለሁ። \q በአንተ ሰረገሎችንና ነጂዎቻቸውን እሰባብራለሁ።

hi.L: और तुमसे मैं घोड़े और उसके सवार को चूर-चूर करता हूँ, \q और तुमसे मैं रथ और उसके सवार को चूर-चूर करता हूँ;
hi.B: तुमसे मैं घोड़े और सवार को चूर-चूर करता हूँ; \q तुमसे मैं रथ और सारथी को चूर-चूर करता हूँ;
hi.R: तुमसे मैं घोड़ों और उनके सवारों को कुचल डालता हूँ। \q तुमसे मैं रथों और उनके सारथियों को कुचल डालता हूँ।

ru.L: и тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сокрушаю коня и его всадника, \q и тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сокрушаю колесницу и её седока;
ru.B: тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сокрушаю коня и всадника; \q тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сокрушаю колесницу и возничего;
ru.R: Тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} разбиваю коней и их всадников. \q Тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} разбиваю колесницы и их возничих.

ja.L: わたしはおまえで馬とその乗り手を打ち砕き、 \q おまえで戦車とその乗り手を打ち砕く。
ja.B: わたしはおまえで馬と騎手を打ち砕き、 \q おまえで戦車と御者を打ち砕く。
ja.R: わたしはおまえで、馬とそれに乗る者を打ち砕く。 \q おまえで、戦車とそれを走らせる者を打ち砕く。

decisions.choice: chariot and its rider: the war chariot and the man who drives it
decisions.reason: The same word "rider" is used for one on horseback and one in a chariot. Horses and chariots were the strength of an ancient army (Exodus 15:1, 21; Psalm 20:8).

decisions.choice: driver
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "driver" for the one who rides in a chariot. The repeated phrase stays as in verse 20.

decisions.choice: возничий
decisions.reason: The one who rides in a war chariot drives it (m1); Balanced and Readable say "возничий", as the English says "driver". The repeated phrase stays as in verse 20.

source.text: וְנִפַּצְתִּ֤י בְךָ֙ אִ֣ישׁ וְאִשָּׁ֔ה וְנִפַּצְתִּ֥י בְךָ֖ זָקֵ֣ן וָנָ֑עַר וְנִפַּצְתִּ֣י בְךָ֔ בָּח֖וּר וּבְתוּלָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I shatter with you man and woman, and I shatter with you old [man] and youth, and I shatter with you young man and young woman.

en.L: and with you I shatter man and woman, \q and with you I shatter old and young, \q and with you I shatter young man and young woman;
en.B: with you I shatter man and woman; \q with you I shatter old and young; \q with you I shatter young man and young woman;
en.R: With you I smash men and women. \q With you I smash old people and young people. \q With you I smash young men and young women.

es.L: y contigo quebranto hombre y mujer, \q y contigo quebranto viejo y muchacho, \q y contigo quebranto joven y doncella;
es.B: contigo quebranto hombre y mujer; \q contigo quebranto viejo y niño; \q contigo quebranto joven y muchacha;
es.R: Contigo hago pedazos a hombres y mujeres. \q Contigo hago pedazos a viejos y niños. \q Contigo hago pedazos a muchachos y muchachas.

fr.L: et par toi je brise l’homme et la femme, \q et par toi je brise le vieillard et le jeune garçon, \q et par toi je brise le jeune homme et la jeune fille ;
fr.B: par toi je brise l’homme et la femme ; \q par toi je brise le vieillard et l’enfant ; \q par toi je brise le jeune homme et la jeune fille ;
fr.R: Avec toi, j’écrase les hommes et les femmes. \q Avec toi, j’écrase les vieux et les jeunes. \q Avec toi, j’écrase les jeunes gens et les jeunes filles.

sw.L: na kwa wewe ninavunjavunja mwanamume na mwanamke, \q na kwa wewe ninavunjavunja mzee na kijana, \q na kwa wewe ninavunjavunja kijana na msichana;
sw.B: kwa wewe ninavunjavunja mwanamume na mwanamke; \q kwa wewe ninavunjavunja mzee na kijana; \q kwa wewe ninavunjavunja kijana na msichana;
sw.R: Kwa wewe ninawaponda wanaume na wanawake. \q Kwa wewe ninawaponda wazee na vijana. \q Kwa wewe ninawaponda vijana wa kiume na wasichana.

vi.L: với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đập tan đàn ông và đàn bà, \q với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đập tan người già và người trẻ, \q với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đập tan thanh niên và thiếu nữ;
vi.B: với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đập tan đàn ông và đàn bà; \q với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đập tan người già và người trẻ; \q với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đập tan thanh niên và thiếu nữ;
vi.R: Với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đập nát đàn ông và đàn bà. \q Với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đập nát người già và người trẻ. \q Với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đập nát thanh niên và thiếu nữ.

ko.L: 내가 너로 남자와 여자를 부수고, \q 내가 너로 늙은이와 젊은이를 부수고, \q 내가 너로 청년과 처녀를 부순다.
ko.B: 내가 너로 남자와 여자를 부수고, \q 내가 너로 노인과 아이를 부수고, \q 내가 너로 청년과 처녀를 부순다.
ko.R: 내가 너로 남자들과 여자들을 부순다. \q 내가 너로 늙은 사람들과 어린 사람들을 부순다. \q 내가 너로 젊은 남자들과 젊은 여자들을 부순다.

pt.L: e contigo despedaço homem e mulher, \q e contigo despedaço velho e moço, \q e contigo despedaço rapaz e moça;
pt.B: contigo despedaço homem e mulher; \q contigo despedaço velho e moço; \q contigo despedaço rapaz e moça;
pt.R: Contigo esmago homens e mulheres. \q Contigo esmago velhos e jovens. \q Contigo esmago rapazes e moças.

am.L: በአንተም ወንድንና ሴትን እሰባብራለሁ፤ \q በአንተም ሽማግሌንና ብላቴናን እሰባብራለሁ፤ \q በአንተም ጎበዝንና ልጃገረድን እሰባብራለሁ፤
am.B: በአንተ ወንድንና ሴትን እሰባብራለሁ፤ \q በአንተ ሽማግሌንና ወጣትን እሰባብራለሁ፤ \q በአንተ ጎበዝንና ልጃገረድን እሰባብራለሁ፤
am.R: በአንተ ወንዶችንና ሴቶችን እሰባብራለሁ። \q በአንተ ሽማግሌዎችንና ወጣቶችን እሰባብራለሁ። \q በአንተ ወጣት ወንዶችንና ወጣት ሴቶችን እሰባብራለሁ።

hi.L: और तुमसे मैं पुरुष और स्त्री को चूर-चूर करता हूँ, \q और तुमसे मैं बूढ़े और लड़के को चूर-चूर करता हूँ, \q और तुमसे मैं जवान और कुँवारी को चूर-चूर करता हूँ;
hi.B: तुमसे मैं पुरुष और स्त्री को चूर-चूर करता हूँ; \q तुमसे मैं बूढ़े और जवान को चूर-चूर करता हूँ; \q तुमसे मैं युवक और युवती को चूर-चूर करता हूँ;
hi.R: तुमसे मैं पुरुषों और स्त्रियों को कुचल डालता हूँ। \q तुमसे मैं बूढ़ों और जवानों को कुचल डालता हूँ। \q तुमसे मैं युवकों और युवतियों को कुचल डालता हूँ।

ru.L: и тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сокрушаю мужчину и женщину, \q и тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сокрушаю старого и юного, \q и тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сокрушаю юношу и девушку;
ru.B: тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сокрушаю мужчину и женщину; \q тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сокрушаю старого и молодого; \q тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сокрушаю юношу и девушку;
ru.R: Тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} разбиваю мужчин и женщин. \q Тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} разбиваю стариков и молодых. \q Тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} разбиваю юношей и девушек.

ja.L: わたしはおまえで男と女を打ち砕き、 \q おまえで老人と若者を打ち砕き、 \q おまえで若い男とおとめを打ち砕く。
ja.B: わたしはおまえで男と女を打ち砕き、 \q おまえで年老いた者と幼い者を打ち砕き、 \q おまえで若い男と若い女を打ち砕く。
ja.R: わたしはおまえで、男も女も打ち砕く。 \q おまえで、年寄りも子どもも打ち砕く。 \q おまえで、若い男も若い女も打ち砕く。

decisions.choice: pairs that take in everyone
decisions.reason: The pairs, man and woman, old and young, young man and young woman, are a way of saying "all people" (compare 6:11). The word for "young" in the second pair often means a boy or youth.

decisions.choice: the repeated phrase kept
decisions.reason: As in verse 20.

source.text: וְנִפַּצְתִּ֤י בְךָ֙ רֹעֶ֣ה וְעֶדְר֔וֹ וְנִפַּצְתִּ֥י בְךָ֖ אִכָּ֣ר וְצִמְדּ֑וֹ וְנִפַּצְתִּ֣י בְךָ֔ פַּח֖וֹת וּסְגָנִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And I shatter with you shepherd and his flock, and I shatter with you farmer and his team, and I shatter with you governors and officials.

en.L: and with you I shatter shepherd and his flock, \q and with you I shatter farmer and his team, \q and with you I shatter governors and officials.
en.B: with you I shatter shepherd and flock; \q with you I shatter farmer and team of oxen; \q with you I shatter governors and officials.
en.R: With you I smash shepherds and their flocks. \q With you I smash farmers and the oxen that pull their plows. \q With you I smash governors and officials.

es.L: y contigo quebranto pastor y su rebaño, \q y contigo quebranto labrador y su yunta, \q y contigo quebranto gobernadores y magistrados.
es.B: contigo quebranto pastor y rebaño; \q contigo quebranto labrador y yunta de bueyes; \q contigo quebranto gobernadores y magistrados.
es.R: Contigo hago pedazos a los pastores y a sus rebaños. \q Contigo hago pedazos a los agricultores y a los bueyes que tiran de sus arados. \q Contigo hago pedazos a gobernadores y funcionarios.

fr.L: et par toi je brise le berger et son troupeau, \q et par toi je brise le laboureur et son attelage, \q et par toi je brise les gouverneurs et les magistrats.
fr.B: par toi je brise berger et troupeau ; \q par toi je brise laboureur et attelage de bœufs ; \q par toi je brise gouverneurs et magistrats.
fr.R: Avec toi, j’écrase les bergers et leurs troupeaux. \q Avec toi, j’écrase les paysans et les bœufs qui tirent leur charrue. \q Avec toi, j’écrase les gouverneurs et les magistrats.

sw.L: na kwa wewe ninavunjavunja mchungaji na kundi lake, \q na kwa wewe ninavunjavunja mkulima na jozi yake ya ng'ombe, \q na kwa wewe ninavunjavunja maliwali na maafisa.
sw.B: kwa wewe ninavunjavunja mchungaji na kundi; \q kwa wewe ninavunjavunja mkulima na jozi ya ng'ombe wa kulimia; \q kwa wewe ninavunjavunja maliwali na maafisa.
sw.R: Kwa wewe ninawaponda wachungaji na makundi yao. \q Kwa wewe ninawaponda wakulima na ng'ombe wanaovuta majembe yao. \q Kwa wewe ninawaponda maliwali na maafisa.

vi.L: với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đập tan người chăn và bầy chiên của nó, \q với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đập tan người làm ruộng và cặp bò cày của nó, \q với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đập tan các tổng đốc và các quan chức.
vi.B: với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đập tan người chăn và bầy chiên; \q với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đập tan nhà nông và cặp bò cày; \q với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đập tan các tổng đốc và các quan chức.
vi.R: Với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đập nát người chăn và bầy chiên của họ. \q Với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đập nát nhà nông và đôi bò kéo cày của họ. \q Với ngươi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đập nát các tổng đốc và các quan chức.

ko.L: 내가 너로 목자와 그의 양 떼를 부수고, \q 내가 너로 농부와 그의 겨릿소를 부수고, \q 내가 너로 총독들과 관리들을 부순다.
ko.B: 내가 너로 목자와 양 떼를 부수고, \q 내가 너로 농부와 밭 가는 소를 부수고, \q 내가 너로 총독들과 고관들을 부순다.
ko.R: 내가 너로 목자들과 그들의 양 떼를 부순다. \q 내가 너로 농부들과 쟁기를 끄는 소들을 부순다. \q 내가 너로 총독들과 관리들을 부순다.

pt.L: e contigo despedaço o pastor e o seu rebanho, \q e contigo despedaço o lavrador e a sua junta, \q e contigo despedaço governadores e oficiais.
pt.B: contigo despedaço pastor e rebanho; \q contigo despedaço lavrador e junta de bois; \q contigo despedaço governadores e oficiais.
pt.R: Contigo esmago os pastores e os seus rebanhos. \q Contigo esmago os lavradores e os bois que puxam os seus arados. \q Contigo esmago governadores e oficiais.

am.L: በአንተም እረኛንና መንጋውን እሰባብራለሁ፤ \q በአንተም አራሹንና ጥማዱን እሰባብራለሁ፤ \q በአንተም አገረ ገዦችንና ሹማምንትን እሰባብራለሁ።
am.B: በአንተ እረኛንና መንጋውን እሰባብራለሁ፤ \q በአንተ ገበሬንና ጥማድ በሬዎቹን እሰባብራለሁ፤ \q በአንተ አገረ ገዦችንና ሹማምንትን እሰባብራለሁ።
am.R: በአንተ እረኞችንና መንጎቻቸውን እሰባብራለሁ። \q በአንተ ገበሬዎችንና ማረሻቸውን የሚጎትቱ በሬዎችን እሰባብራለሁ። \q በአንተ አገረ ገዦችንና ባለ ሥልጣናትን እሰባብራለሁ።

hi.L: और तुमसे मैं चरवाहे और उसके झुंड को चूर-चूर करता हूँ, \q और तुमसे मैं किसान और उसकी जोड़ी को चूर-चूर करता हूँ, \q और तुमसे मैं राज्यपालों और हाकिमों को चूर-चूर करता हूँ।
hi.B: तुमसे मैं चरवाहे और झुंड को चूर-चूर करता हूँ; \q तुमसे मैं किसान और बैलों की जोड़ी को चूर-चूर करता हूँ; \q तुमसे मैं राज्यपालों और अधिकारियों को चूर-चूर करता हूँ।
hi.R: तुमसे मैं चरवाहों और उनके झुंडों को कुचल डालता हूँ। \q तुमसे मैं किसानों और उनके हल खींचनेवाले बैलों को कुचल डालता हूँ। \q तुमसे मैं राज्यपालों और अधिकारियों को कुचल डालता हूँ।

ru.L: и тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сокрушаю пастуха и его стадо, \q и тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сокрушаю пахаря и его упряжку, \q и тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сокрушаю наместников и начальников.
ru.B: тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сокрушаю пастуха и стадо; \q тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сокрушаю пахаря и упряжку волов; \q тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сокрушаю наместников и начальников.
ru.R: Тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} разбиваю пастухов и их стада. \q Тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} разбиваю пахарей и волов, которые тянут их плуги. \q Тобой {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} разбиваю правителей и начальников.

ja.L: わたしはおまえで羊飼いとその群れを打ち砕き、 \q おまえで農夫とその一くびきの牛を打ち砕き、 \q おまえで総督たちと長官たちを打ち砕く。
ja.B: わたしはおまえで羊飼いと群れを打ち砕き、 \q おまえで農夫と一対の牛を打ち砕き、 \q おまえで総督たちと長官たちを打ち砕く。
ja.R: わたしはおまえで、羊飼いとその羊の群れを打ち砕く。 \q おまえで、農夫とすきを引く牛を打ち砕く。 \q おまえで、総督や役人たちを打ち砕く。

decisions.choice: his team: the pair of oxen yoked to the plow
decisions.reason: The word means a pair, a yoke of oxen working together (1 Samuel 11:7; 1 Kings 19:19).

decisions.choice: governors and officials: titles of rulers in the empires of the day
decisions.reason: Both words came into Hebrew from the language of Assyria and Babylon. They name provincial governors and lesser officials (verses 28, 57; Isaiah 41:25; Ezekiel 23:6). The list runs from the herdsman to the rulers: no one is beyond the club's reach.

decisions.choice: team of oxen (B); the oxen that pull their plows (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the team is (m1).

decisions.choice: "राज्यपाल" for pahot; "हाकिम" (L), "अधिकारी" (B, R) for seganim
decisions.reason: Governor is "राज्यपाल", as Ezra and Nehemiah; the second title (seganim) takes the word for officials at each level.

decisions.choice: наместники и начальники (L, B); правители и начальники (R)
decisions.reason: Titles of rulers in the empires of the day (m2); "наместник" as the governor (pechah) in Ezra in this translation, "правитель" at Readable.

decisions.choice: pachot useganim "総督たち" / "長官たち" (L, B), "総督や役人たち" (R), kept the same in 51:28 and 51:57.
decisions.reason: m2: imperial titles.

source.text: וְשִׁלַּמְתִּ֨י לְבָבֶ֜ל וּלְכֹ֣ל׀יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י כַשְׂדִּ֗ים אֵ֧ת כָּל־רָעָתָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂ֥וּ בְצִיּ֖וֹן לְעֵֽינֵיכֶ֑ם נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And I will repay to Babylon and to all [the] inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they did in Zion before your eyes, declares Yahweh.

en.L: And I will repay Babylon and all the inhabitants of Chaldea \q for all their evil that they have done in Zion before your eyes, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: But I will repay Babylon and all who live in Chaldea \q for all the evil they have done in Zion before your eyes, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: But I will pay back Babylon and all the people of Babylonia \q for all the evil they did in Jerusalem while you watched, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y pagaré a Babilonia y a todos los habitantes de Caldea \q todo el mal que hicieron en Sion delante de {{plural_you:sus ojos|vuestros ojos}}, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Pero pagaré a Babilonia y a todos los que viven en Caldea \q por todo el mal que han hecho en Sion delante de {{plural_you:sus ojos|vuestros ojos}}, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Pero le daré su merecido a Babilonia y a toda la gente de Babilonia \q por todo el mal que hicieron en Jerusalén mientras {{plural_you:ustedes miraban|vosotros mirabais}}, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et je rendrai à Babylone et à tous les habitants de la Chaldée \q tout le mal qu’ils ont fait dans Sion sous vos yeux, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Mais je rendrai à Babylone et à tous les habitants de la Chaldée \q tout le mal qu’ils ont fait dans Sion sous vos yeux, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Mais je ferai payer Babylone et tous les habitants de la Babylonie \q pour tout le mal qu’ils ont fait à Jérusalem sous vos yeux, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Nami nitailipa Babeli na wakaaji wote wa Ukaldayo \q kwa ajili ya mabaya yao yote waliyoyatenda katika Sayuni mbele ya macho yenu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Lakini nitailipa Babeli na wote wanaoishi Ukaldayo \q kwa ajili ya mabaya yote waliyoyatenda katika Sayuni mbele ya macho yenu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Lakini nitailipiza Babeli na watu wote wa nchi ya Babeli \q kwa ajili ya mabaya yote waliyoyatenda Yerusalemu mkiwa mnatazama, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Ta sẽ báo trả Ba-by-lôn và mọi dân cư xứ Canh-đê \q vì mọi điều ác chúng đã làm tại Si-ôn trước mắt các ngươi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ báo trả Ba-by-lôn và mọi kẻ sống trong xứ Canh-đê \q vì mọi điều ác chúng đã làm tại Si-ôn ngay trước mắt các ngươi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ báo trả Ba-by-lôn và mọi dân trong xứ Ba-by-lôn \q vì mọi điều ác chúng đã làm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem ngay trước mắt các ngươi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 바빌론과 갈대아의 모든 주민에게 \q 그들이 너희 눈앞에서 시온에서 행한 그들의 모든 악을 갚겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 그러나 내가 바빌론과 갈대아에 사는 모든 사람에게 \q 그들이 너희가 보는 앞에서 시온에서 저지른 모든 악을 갚겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 그러나 나는 바빌론과 바빌로니아의 모든 사람에게 \q 그들이 너희가 보는 앞에서 예루살렘에서 저지른 모든 악한 일을 갚겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

pt.L: E retribuirei à Babilônia e a todos os moradores da Caldeia \q todo o mal que fizeram em Sião diante dos olhos de vocês, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Mas retribuirei à Babilônia e a todos os que moram na Caldeia \q todo o mal que fizeram em Sião diante dos olhos de vocês, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Mas vou fazer a Babilônia e todo o povo babilônio pagarem \q por todo o mal que fizeram em Jerusalém enquanto vocês olhavam, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

am.L: ለባቢሎንና ለከለዳ ነዋሪዎች ሁሉ \q በዓይናችሁ ፊት በጽዮን ስላደረጉት ክፋታቸው ሁሉ እከፍላቸዋለሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.B: ነገር ግን ባቢሎንንና በከለዳ የሚኖሩትን ሁሉ \q በዓይናችሁ ፊት በጽዮን ስላደረጉት ክፋት ሁሉ እከፍላቸዋለሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.R: ነገር ግን ባቢሎንንና የባቢሎንን ምድር ሕዝብ ሁሉ \q እናንተ እያያችሁ በኢየሩሳሌም ስላደረጉት ክፋት ሁሉ እበቀላቸዋለሁ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።

hi.L: और मैं बाबुल को और कसदिया के सब निवासियों को \q उनकी सारी बुराई का बदला दूँगा जो उन्होंने तुम्हारी आँखों के सामने सिय्योन में की है, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.B: पर मैं बाबुल को और कसदिया में रहनेवाले सब लोगों को \q उस सारी बुराई का बदला दूँगा जो उन्होंने तुम्हारी आँखों के सामने सिय्योन में की है, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.R: पर मैं बाबुल से और बाबुल देश के सब लोगों से \q उस सारी बुराई का बदला चुकाऊँगा जो उन्होंने तुम्हारे देखते-देखते यरूशलेम में की, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं।

ru.L: И воздам {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} Вавилону и всем жителям Халдеи \q за всё их зло, которое они сделали на Сионе на ваших глазах, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Но {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} воздам Вавилону и всем, кто живёт в Халдее, \q за всё зло, которое они сделали на Сионе у вас на глазах, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Но {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} воздам Вавилону и всем жителям Вавилонии \q за всё зло, которое они сделали в Иерусалиме, пока вы смотрели, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: わたしは、バビロンとカルデアのすべての住民に、 \q 彼らがシオンで、あなたがたの目の前で行ったすべての悪に報いる――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――。
ja.B: しかし、わたしは、バビロンとカルデアに住むすべての者に、 \q 彼らがシオンで、あなたがたの目の前で行ったすべての悪の報いを返す、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。
ja.R: しかし、わたしは、バビロンとバビロニアのすべての人々に仕返しをする。 \q 彼らがエルサレムで、あなたたちの見ている前で行ったすべての悪のためだ、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。

decisions.choice: and I will repay: the turn from Babylon's past use to its punishment
decisions.reason: After the ten blows of verses 20-23, the LORD declares that the weapon he used will itself be repaid. The verb is the one used in verses 6 and 56.

decisions.choice: before your eyes: the evil done in Zion while you, the exiles, watched
alternatives: I will repay them before your eyes
decisions.reason: The "your" is plural and speaks to the people of Judah. The phrase most naturally goes with what comes just before it, the evil done in Zion, which they saw with their own eyes. It could also go with the repaying: they will see Babylon punished (50:28).

decisions.choice: Jerusalem; Babylonia; while you watched
decisions.reason: Readable says "Jerusalem" for Zion and "Babylonia" for Chaldea, and "while you watched" for "before your eyes" (m2).

decisions.choice: plural_you (sus ojos / vuestros ojos)
decisions.reason: "Your eyes" is plural: God turns to the people of Judah, who saw what Babylon did.

decisions.choice: Вавилония; Иерусалим
decisions.reason: Readable says "Babylonia" for Chaldea and "Jerusalem" for Zion, as the English does (m2).

decisions.choice: "your eyes" of the exiles "あなたがたの" (L, B), "あなたたちの" (R), the address for God's people; Babylon remains "おまえ".
decisions.reason: m2: the exiles are the ones who saw.

source.text: הִנְנִ֨י אֵלֶ֜יךָ הַ֤ר הַמַּשְׁחִית֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה הַמַּשְׁחִ֖ית אֶת־כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְנָטִ֨יתִי אֶת־יָדִ֜י עָלֶ֗יךָ וְגִלְגַּלְתִּ֨יךָ֙ מִן־הַסְּלָעִ֔ים וּנְתַתִּ֖יךָ לְהַ֥ר שְׂרֵפָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Here I [am] against you, mountain of the destroyer, declares Yahweh, the [one] destroying all the earth; and I will stretch out my hand against you and roll you from the crags and make you a mountain of burning.

en.L: Look, I am against you, O destroying mountain, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q you who destroy all the earth; \q and I will stretch out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand against you and roll you down from the crags, \q and make you a burned mountain.
en.B: I am against you, destroying mountain, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q you who destroy the whole earth. \q I will stretch out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand against you and roll you down from the cliffs, \q and make you a burned-out mountain.
en.R: Babylon, you are like a mountain that destroys the whole earth. \q But now I am against you, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q I will reach out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand against you and roll you down from the cliffs. \q I will make you a mountain burned to ashes.

es.L: He aquí, yo estoy contra ti, monte destructor, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q que destruyes toda la tierra; \q y extenderé {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano contra ti y te haré rodar de las peñas, \q y te convertiré en monte quemado.
es.B: Estoy contra ti, monte destructor, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q tú que destruyes toda la tierra. \q Extenderé {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano contra ti y te haré rodar desde los peñascos, \q y te convertiré en un monte calcinado.
es.R: Babilonia, eres como un monte que destruye toda la tierra. \q Pero ahora yo estoy contra ti, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Extenderé {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano contra ti y te haré rodar desde los peñascos. \q Te convertiré en un monte reducido a cenizas.

fr.L: Voici, je suis contre toi, montagne de destruction, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q toi qui détruis toute la terre ; \q et j’étendrai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main contre toi, et je te roulerai du haut des rochers, \q et je ferai de toi une montagne brûlée.
fr.B: Je suis contre toi, montagne destructrice, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q toi qui détruis la terre entière. \q J’étendrai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main contre toi, je te ferai rouler du haut des falaises, \q et je ferai de toi une montagne calcinée.
fr.R: Babylone, tu es comme une montagne qui détruit toute la terre. \q Mais maintenant je suis contre toi, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q J’étendrai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main contre toi et je te ferai rouler du haut des falaises. \q Je ferai de toi une montagne réduite en cendres.

sw.L: Tazama, mimi ni juu yako, ewe mlima uharibuo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q wewe uiharibuye dunia yote; \q nami nitaunyosha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu yako na kukuvingirisha kutoka katika miamba, \q na kukufanya mlima ulioteketezwa.
sw.B: Mimi niko dhidi yako, ewe mlima uharibuo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q wewe uiharibuye dunia yote. \q Nitaunyosha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} dhidi yako na kukuvingirisha kutoka kwenye majabali, \q na kukufanya mlima ulioteketea.
sw.R: Ewe Babeli, wewe ni kama mlima unaoiharibu dunia yote. \q Lakini sasa mimi niko dhidi yako, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Nitaunyosha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} dhidi yako na kukuvingirisha kutoka kwenye majabali. \q Nitakufanya mlima ulioungua mpaka ukawa majivu.

vi.L: Này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chống lại ngươi, hỡi núi hủy diệt, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, \q là kẻ hủy diệt cả đất; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giơ tay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ra nghịch cùng ngươi, lăn ngươi xuống khỏi các vách đá, \q và làm cho ngươi thành một núi bị thiêu đốt.
vi.B: Hỡi núi hủy diệt, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chống lại ngươi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, \q là kẻ hủy diệt cả trái đất. \q Ta sẽ giơ tay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ra nghịch cùng ngươi, lăn ngươi xuống khỏi các vách đá, \q và làm cho ngươi thành một núi cháy rụi.
vi.R: Hỡi Ba-by-lôn, ngươi giống như một ngọn núi hủy diệt cả trái đất. \q Nhưng nay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chống lại ngươi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. \q Ta sẽ giơ tay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ra đánh ngươi và lăn ngươi xuống khỏi các vách đá. \q Ta sẽ làm cho ngươi thành một ngọn núi cháy ra tro.

ko.L: 보라, 멸망시키는 산아, 내가 너를 대적한다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. \q 온 땅을 멸망시키는 자야, \q 내가 내 손을 너에게 뻗어 너를 바위 꼭대기에서 굴러 떨어뜨리고, \q 너를 불탄 산으로 만들겠다.
ko.B: 멸망시키는 산아, 내가 너를 대적한다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 온 세상을 멸망시키는 자야, \q 내가 내 손을 너에게 뻗어 너를 낭떠러지에서 굴러 떨어뜨리고, \q 너를 다 타 버린 산으로 만들겠다.
ko.R: 바빌론아, 너는 온 세상을 멸망시키는 산과 같다. \q 그러나 이제 나는 너의 원수다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 나는 손을 뻗어 너를 낭떠러지에서 굴러 떨어뜨리겠다. \q 나는 너를 불타서 재만 남은 산으로 만들겠다.

pt.L: Eis que eu [estou] contra ti, ó monte destruidor, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, \q que destróis toda a terra; \q e estenderei a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} mão contra ti e te rolarei dos penhascos, \q e farei de ti um monte queimado.
pt.B: Estou contra ti, monte destruidor, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, \q tu que destróis a terra inteira. \q Estenderei a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} mão contra ti e te rolarei dos penhascos, \q e farei de ti um monte calcinado.
pt.R: Babilônia, tu és como um monte que destrói a terra inteira. \q Mas agora eu estou contra ti, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. \q Vou estender a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} mão contra ti e te rolar dos penhascos. \q Vou fazer de ti um monte reduzido a cinzas.

am.L: አንተ የምታጠፋ ተራራ ሆይ፣ እነሆ፣ እኔ በአንተ ላይ ነኝ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ \q ምድርን ሁሉ የምታጠፋ፤ \q እጄንም በአንተ ላይ እዘረጋለሁ፤ ከዓለቶችም አንከባልልሃለሁ፤ \q የተቃጠለ ተራራም አደርግሃለሁ።
am.B: አንተ አጥፊ ተራራ፣ እኔ በአንተ ላይ ነኝ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ \q ምድርን ሁሉ የምታጠፋ። \q እጄን በአንተ ላይ እዘረጋለሁ፤ ከገደሎችም አንከባልልሃለሁ፤ \q ተቃጥሎ ያለቀ ተራራም አደርግሃለሁ።
am.R: ባቢሎን ሆይ፣ አንቺ ምድርን ሁሉ እንደሚያጠፋ ተራራ ነሽ። \q አሁን ግን እኔ በአንቺ ላይ ነኝ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። \q እጄን በአንቺ ላይ ዘርግቼ ከገደሎች አንከባልልሻለሁ። \q ተቃጥሎ አመድ የሆነ ተራራ አደርግሻለሁ።

hi.L: देखो, हे नाश करनेवाले पहाड़, मैं तुम्हारे विरुद्ध हूँ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, \q तुम जो सारी पृथ्वी को नाश करते हो; \q और मैं तुम्हारे विरुद्ध अपना हाथ बढ़ाकर तुम्हें ऊँची चट्टानों पर से लुढ़का दूँगा, \q और तुम्हें जला हुआ पहाड़ बना दूँगा।
hi.B: हे विनाशकारी पहाड़, मैं तुम्हारे विरुद्ध हूँ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, \q तुम जो सारी पृथ्वी को नाश करते हो। \q मैं तुम्हारे विरुद्ध अपना हाथ बढ़ाकर तुम्हें चट्टानों पर से लुढ़का दूँगा, \q और तुम्हें जलकर राख हुआ पहाड़ बना दूँगा।
hi.R: हे बाबुल, तुम उस पहाड़ जैसे हो जो सारी पृथ्वी को नाश करता है। \q पर अब मैं तुम्हारे विरुद्ध हूँ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं। \q मैं अपना हाथ बढ़ाकर तुम्हें चट्टानों पर से नीचे लुढ़का दूँगा। \q मैं तुम्हें ऐसा पहाड़ बना दूँगा जो जलकर राख हो गया हो।

ru.L: Вот, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} против тебя, гора губительная, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, — \q губящая всю землю; \q и простру {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} руку на тебя, и покачу тебя вниз со скал, \q и сделаю тебя горой сожжённой.
ru.B: Я против тебя, губительная гора, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, — \q ты, губящая всю землю. \q Я простру на тебя {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} руку и покачу тебя вниз с утёсов, \q и сделаю тебя выжженной горой.
ru.R: Вавилон, ты похож на гору, которая губит всю землю. \q Но теперь {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} против тебя, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. \q Я протяну на тебя {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} руку и сброшу тебя вниз со скал. \q Я сделаю тебя горой, сожжённой дотла.

ja.L: 見なさい、わたしはおまえに立ち向かう、滅ぼす山よ――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――、 \q 全地を滅ぼす者よ。 \q わたしはおまえに向かって手を伸ばし、おまえを岩から転がし落とし、 \q おまえを燃え尽きた山とする。
ja.B: わたしはおまえに立ち向かう、滅ぼす山よ、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。 \q 全地を滅ぼす者よ。 \q わたしはおまえに手を伸ばし、おまえを崖から転がし落とし、 \q 焼け尽きた山とする。
ja.R: バビロンよ、おまえは全地を滅ぼす山のようだ。 \q だが今、わたしはおまえの敵だ、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。 \q わたしは手を伸ばしておまえを打ち、崖から転がり落とす。 \q おまえを、焼けて灰になった山にする。

decisions.choice: destroying mountain: Babylon as a towering power that ruins the earth
decisions.reason: Babylon stood on a flat plain, so the mountain is a picture of its height and power, the empire that loomed over the nations (compare Daniel 2:35). The word "destroying" is the one used in verse 1 of the wind God sends: the destroyer is now destroyed. The same phrase names a hill near Jerusalem where Solomon built shrines to foreign gods (2 Kings 23:13), but there is no clear link here.

decisions.choice: rolled from the crags ... a burned mountain: a peak toppled and burned out
decisions.reason: The picture may be of a mountain set on fire and left a heap of burned rock, or of a fortress on the heights thrown down and burned. Either way, Babylon will be left lifeless, good for nothing (verse 26; compare Revelation 8:8).

decisions.choice: stretch out my hand against you: act in judgment
decisions.reason: The phrase is used of the LORD striking a people (6:12; 15:6; Exodus 7:5).

decisions.choice: Babylon, you are like a mountain
decisions.reason: Readable names Babylon and says "like" to show that the mountain is a picture (m1). It puts "says the LORD" in the second sentence so the first can explain the picture.

decisions.choice: the mountain is addressed with "አንተ" (Literal, Balanced), as the Hebrew masculine; Readable names Babylon and uses "አንቺ", as the English.
decisions.reason: The Hebrew speaks to the mountain; the English Readable turns it into a simile for the city.

decisions.choice: Вавилон, ты похож на гору
decisions.reason: Readable names Babylon and marks the mountain as a picture (m1), as the English does.

decisions.choice: har hammashchit "滅ぼす山"; hineni 'eleikha "わたしはおまえに立ち向かう" (L, B), "わたしはおまえの敵だ" (R), as 50:31.
decisions.reason: m1, m3: the repeated formula keeps one wording.

source.text: וְלֹֽא־יִקְח֤וּ מִמְּךָ֙ אֶ֣בֶן לְפִנָּ֔ה וְאֶ֖בֶן לְמֽוֹסָד֑וֹת כִּֽי־שִׁמְמ֥וֹת עוֹלָ֛ם תִּֽהְיֶ֖ה נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And not they will take from you a stone for a corner, or a stone for foundations; for desolations of forever you will be, declares Yahweh.

en.L: And they will not take from you a stone for a corner \q or a stone for foundations, \q for you will be a desolation forever, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: No one will take a cornerstone from you, \q or any stone for a foundation, \q for you will be a desolation forever, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: No one will take a single stone from you \q to build the corner or the foundation of a house. \q You will be an empty ruin forever, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y no tomarán de ti piedra para esquina \q ni piedra para cimientos, \q porque serás desolación perpetua, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Nadie sacará de ti una piedra angular \q ni una piedra para cimientos, \q porque serás una desolación para siempre, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Nadie sacará de ti ni una sola piedra \q para construir la esquina o los cimientos de una casa. \q Serás una ruina vacía para siempre, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et on ne prendra pas de toi une pierre pour l’angle, \q ni une pierre pour les fondations, \q car tu seras une désolation pour toujours, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: On ne tirera de toi ni pierre d’angle \q ni pierre de fondation, \q car tu seras une désolation pour toujours, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Personne ne prendra chez toi une seule pierre \q pour construire l’angle ou les fondations d’une maison. \q Tu seras une ruine vide pour toujours, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Wala hawatachukua kwako jiwe la pembeni, \q wala jiwe la misingi, \q kwa maana utakuwa ukiwa wa milele, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Hakuna atakayechukua kwako jiwe la pembeni, \q wala jiwe lolote la msingi, \q kwa maana utakuwa ukiwa milele, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Hakuna mtu atakayechukua hata jiwe moja kwako \q ili kujenga pembe au msingi wa nyumba. \q Utakuwa magofu matupu milele, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Người ta sẽ không lấy từ ngươi một tảng đá làm góc nhà \q hay một tảng đá làm nền móng, \q vì ngươi sẽ hoang vu mãi mãi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Sẽ không ai lấy từ ngươi một tảng đá góc nhà, \q hay một tảng đá nào làm nền móng, \q vì ngươi sẽ hoang tàn mãi mãi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Sẽ không ai lấy một tảng đá nào của ngươi \q để xây góc hay nền móng một ngôi nhà. \q Ngươi sẽ là đống đổ nát vắng tanh mãi mãi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 네게서 모퉁잇돌로 쓸 돌 하나도, \q 기초로 쓸 돌 하나도 가져가지 않을 것이다. \q 네가 영원한 황무지가 될 것이기 때문이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 아무도 네게서 모퉁잇돌을 가져가지 않고, \q 기초로 쓸 돌 하나도 가져가지 않을 것이다. \q 너는 영원히 황무지가 될 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 아무도 너에게서 \q 집 모퉁이나 기초를 놓을 돌 하나도 가져가지 않을 것이다. \q 너는 영원히 텅 빈 폐허로 남을 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

pt.L: E não tirarão de ti pedra para esquina, \q nem pedra para alicerces, \q pois serás uma desolação para sempre, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Ninguém tirará de ti uma pedra de esquina, \q nem pedra alguma para alicerce, \q pois serás uma desolação para sempre, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Ninguém vai tirar de ti uma só pedra \q para construir a esquina ou o alicerce de uma casa. \q Vais ser uma ruína vazia para sempre, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

am.L: ከአንተም የማዕዘን ድንጋይ፣ \q ለመሠረትም ድንጋይ አይወስዱም፤ \q ለዘላለም ባድማ ትሆናለህና፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.B: ማንም ከአንተ የማዕዘን ድንጋይ፣ \q ወይም ለመሠረት የሚሆን ድንጋይ አይወስድም፤ \q ለዘላለም ባድማ ትሆናለህና፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.R: ማንም ከአንቺ አንድ ድንጋይ እንኳ \q ለቤት ማዕዘን ወይም ለመሠረት አይወስድም። \q ለዘላለም ባዶ ፍርስራሽ ትሆኛለሽ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።

hi.L: और वे तुम में से न कोने के लिए पत्थर लेंगे, \q न नींव के लिए पत्थर, \q क्योंकि तुम सदा के लिए उजाड़ रहोगे, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.B: कोई तुम में से कोने का पत्थर न लेगा, \q न नींव के लिए कोई पत्थर, \q क्योंकि तुम सदा के लिए उजाड़ रहोगे, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.R: कोई भी तुम में से एक पत्थर तक नहीं लेगा \q किसी घर का कोना या नींव बनाने के लिए। \q तुम सदा के लिए सूना खंडहर बने रहोगे, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं।

ru.L: И не возьмут из тебя камня для угла \q и камня для оснований, \q ведь пустошью вечной ты будешь, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Никто не возьмёт из тебя краеугольного камня \q или камня для основания, \q ведь ты навсегда останешься пустошью, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Никто не возьмёт из тебя ни одного камня, \q чтобы построить угол или основание дома. \q Ты навсегда останешься пустыми развалинами, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: 人々はおまえから、隅の石も、 \q 土台の石も取らない。 \q おまえはとこしえの荒れ果てた所となるからだ――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――。
ja.B: だれもおまえから、隅の石を取らず、 \q 土台の石も取らない。 \q おまえは永遠に荒れ果てた所となるからだ、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。
ja.R: だれも、おまえから石一つ取って、 \q 家の隅や土台を造ることはない。 \q おまえはいつまでも、何もない廃墟のままになる、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。

decisions.choice: a stone for a corner or for foundations: the best stones, used to start a building
decisions.reason: The cornerstone and foundation stones had to be large and sound (Isaiah 28:16; Psalm 118:22). A burned mountain would yield no stone good enough even for that: nothing in Babylon will be fit to build again.

decisions.choice: a desolation forever: a ruin that will last
decisions.reason: The plural "desolations" stresses how complete the ruin is. Verse 62 uses the same words.

decisions.choice: to build the corner or the foundation of a house
decisions.reason: Readable says what the stones are used for (m1).

source.text: שְׂאוּ־נֵ֣ס בָּאָ֗רֶץ תִּקְע֨וּ שׁוֹפָ֤ר בַּגּוֹיִם֙ קַדְּשׁ֤וּ עָלֶ֨יהָ֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם הַשְׁמִ֧יעוּ עָלֶ֛יהָ מַמְלְכ֥וֹת אֲרָרַ֖ט מִנִּ֣י וְאַשְׁכְּנָ֑ז פִּקְד֤וּ עָלֶ֨יהָ֙ טִפְסָ֔ר הַֽעֲלוּ־ס֖וּס כְּיֶ֥לֶק סָמָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Lift up a signal flag in the land; blow a horn among [the] nations; consecrate against her nations; summon against her [the] kingdoms of Ararat, Minni and Ashkenaz; appoint against her a marshal; bring up horse like bristling locusts.

en.L: Raise a signal flag in the land; blow the trumpet among the nations; consecrate nations against her; \q summon against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni and Ashkenaz; \q appoint a marshal against her; \q bring up horses like bristling locusts.
en.B: Raise a signal flag in the land! Sound the ram's horn among the nations! Set apart nations for holy war against her; \q summon against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni and Ashkenaz! \q Appoint a commander against her; \q send up horses like a swarm of bristling locusts!
en.R: Raise a signal flag in the land! Blow the trumpet among the nations! Get the nations ready to fight against Babylon. \q Call the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni and Ashkenaz to attack her. \q Choose a commander to lead the attack. \q Send so many horses that they look like a swarm of locusts.

es.L: {{plural_you:Alcen|Alzad}} bandera en la tierra; {{plural_you:toquen|tocad}} trompeta entre las naciones; {{plural_you:consagren|consagrad}} naciones contra ella; \q {{plural_you:convoquen|convocad}} contra ella a los reinos de Ararat, Mini y Askenaz; \q {{plural_you:nombren|nombrad}} contra ella un capitán; \q {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} subir caballos como langostas erizadas.
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Alcen|Alzad}} una bandera en la tierra! ¡{{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} el cuerno de carnero entre las naciones! {{plural_you:Preparen|Preparad}} a las naciones para la guerra santa contra ella; \q ¡{{plural_you:convoquen|convocad}} contra ella a los reinos de Ararat, Mini y Askenaz! \q {{plural_you:Nombren|Nombrad}} un comandante contra ella; \q ¡{{plural_you:hagan|haced}} subir caballos como un enjambre de langostas erizadas!
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Alcen|Alzad}} una bandera en la tierra! ¡{{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} la trompeta entre las naciones! {{plural_you:Preparen|Preparad}} a las naciones para pelear contra Babilonia. \q {{plural_you:Llamen|Llamad}} a los reinos de Ararat, Mini y Askenaz para que la ataquen. \q {{plural_you:Escojan|Escoged}} un comandante que dirija el ataque. \q {{plural_you:Envíen|Enviad}} tantos caballos que parezcan un enjambre de langostas.

fr.L: Levez un étendard dans le pays ; sonnez du cor parmi les nations ; consacrez des nations contre elle ; \q convoquez contre elle les royaumes d’Ararat, de Minni et d’Ashkenaz ; \q établissez contre elle un chef de guerre ; \q faites monter des chevaux comme des sauterelles hérissées.
fr.B: Levez un étendard dans le pays ! Sonnez du cor parmi les nations ! Préparez des nations à la guerre sainte contre elle ; \q appelez contre elle les royaumes d’Ararat, de Minni et d’Ashkenaz ! \q Nommez un commandant contre elle ; \q faites monter des chevaux comme un essaim de sauterelles hérissées !
fr.R: Levez un drapeau dans le pays ! Sonnez de la trompette parmi les nations ! Préparez les nations à combattre Babylone. \q Appelez les royaumes d’Ararat, de Minni et d’Ashkenaz à l’attaquer. \q Choisissez un commandant pour mener l’attaque. \q Envoyez tant de chevaux qu’on dirait un nuage de sauterelles.

sw.L: Inueni bendera katika nchi; pigeni baragumu kati ya mataifa; yawekeni mataifa wakfu juu yake; \q iteni juu yake falme za Ararati, Mini na Ashkenazi; \q wekeni jemadari juu yake; \q pandisheni farasi kama nzige wenye manyoya magumu.
sw.B: Inueni bendera katika nchi! Pigeni baragumu kati ya mataifa! Yawekeni mataifa tayari kwa vita vitakatifu dhidi yake; \q iteni juu yake falme za Ararati, Mini na Ashkenazi! \q Wekeni kamanda dhidi yake; \q leteni farasi wengi kama kundi la nzige wenye manyoya magumu!
sw.R: Inueni bendera katika nchi! Pigeni baragumu kati ya mataifa! Yaandaeni mataifa kupigana na Babeli. \q Ziiteni falme za Ararati, Mini na Ashkenazi zimshambulie. \q Chagueni kamanda wa kuongoza mashambulizi. \q Pelekeni farasi wengi sana hata waonekane kama kundi la nzige.

vi.L: Hãy dựng cờ hiệu trong xứ; hãy thổi kèn giữa các dân tộc; hãy biệt riêng các dân tộc ra để đánh nó; \q hãy triệu tập các vương quốc A-ra-rát, Min-ni và Ách-kê-na đến đánh nó; \q hãy lập một tướng chỉ huy đánh nó; \q hãy đem ngựa lên như cào cào tua tủa.
vi.B: Hãy dựng cờ hiệu trong xứ! Hãy thổi tù và giữa các dân tộc! Hãy biệt riêng các dân tộc cho cuộc thánh chiến nghịch cùng nó; \q hãy triệu tập các vương quốc A-ra-rát, Min-ni và Ách-kê-na đến đánh nó! \q Hãy lập một tướng chỉ huy đánh nó; \q hãy đưa ngựa lên đông như đàn cào cào tua tủa!
vi.R: Hãy dựng cờ hiệu trong xứ! Hãy thổi kèn giữa các dân tộc! Hãy chuẩn bị các dân tộc chiến đấu chống lại Ba-by-lôn. \q Hãy gọi các vương quốc A-ra-rát, Min-ni và Ách-kê-na đến tấn công nó. \q Hãy chọn một tướng chỉ huy dẫn đầu cuộc tấn công. \q Hãy sai thật nhiều ngựa đến, đông như một đàn cào cào.

ko.L: 땅에 깃발을 올려라. 민족들 가운데 나팔을 불어라. 민족들을 구별하여 그를 치게 하여라. \q 아라랏과 민니와 아스그나스 왕국들을 불러 그를 치게 하여라. \q 그를 칠 사령관을 세워라. \q 털이 곤두선 메뚜기 떼처럼 말들을 올려 보내라.
ko.B: 땅에 신호 깃발을 올려라! 민족들 가운데 숫양 뿔 나팔을 불어라! 거룩한 전쟁을 위하여 민족들을 구별하여 그를 치게 하여라. \q 아라랏과 민니와 아스그나스 왕국들을 불러 그를 치게 하여라! \q 그를 칠 사령관을 세워라. \q 날개가 곤두선 메뚜기 떼처럼 말들을 올려 보내라!
ko.R: 땅에 깃발을 올려라! 민족들 가운데 나팔을 불어라! 민족들이 바빌론과 싸울 준비를 하게 하여라. \q 아라랏과 민니와 아스그나스 왕국들을 불러 바빌론을 공격하게 하여라. \q 공격을 이끌 사령관을 세워라. \q 메뚜기 떼처럼 보일 만큼 많은 말을 보내라.

pt.L: Levantem uma bandeira na terra; toquem o chifre de carneiro entre as nações; consagrem nações contra ela; \q convoquem contra ela os reinos de Ararate, Mini e Asquenaz; \q nomeiem contra ela um comandante; \q façam subir cavalos como gafanhotos eriçados.
pt.B: Levantem uma bandeira de sinal na terra! Toquem o chifre de carneiro entre as nações! Separem nações para a guerra santa contra ela; \q convoquem contra ela os reinos de Ararate, Mini e Asquenaz! \q Nomeiem um comandante contra ela; \q mandem subir cavalos como um enxame de gafanhotos eriçados!
pt.R: Levantem uma bandeira de sinal na terra! Toquem a trombeta entre as nações! Preparem as nações para lutar contra a Babilônia. \q Chamem os reinos de Ararate, Mini e Asquenaz para atacá-la. \q Escolham um comandante para liderar o ataque. \q Mandem tantos cavalos que pareçam um enxame de gafanhotos.

am.L: በምድር ላይ ዓላማ አንሡ፤ በሕዝቦች መካከል መለከት ንፉ፤ ሕዝቦችን በእርሷ ላይ ቀድሱ፤ \q የአራራትን፣ የሚኒንና የአስከናዝን መንግሥታት በእርሷ ላይ ጥሩ፤ \q በእርሷ ላይ የጦር አለቃ ሹሙ፤ \q ክንፋቸው እንደ ቆመ አንበጣ ፈረሶችን አውጡ።
am.B: በምድሪቱ ላይ የምልክት ዓላማ አንሡ! በሕዝቦች መካከል የቀንድ መለከት ንፉ! ሕዝቦችን ለተቀደሰ ጦርነት በእርሷ ላይ ለዩ፤ \q የአራራትን፣ የሚኒንና የአስከናዝን መንግሥታት በእርሷ ላይ ጥሩ! \q በእርሷ ላይ የጦር አዛዥ ሹሙ፤ \q ክንፋቸው እንደ ቆመ የአንበጣ መንጋ ፈረሶችን አውጡ!
am.R: በምድሪቱ ላይ የምልክት ዓላማ አንሡ! በሕዝቦች መካከል መለከት ንፉ! ሕዝቦችን ባቢሎንን ለመውጋት አዘጋጁ። \q የአራራትን፣ የሚኒንና የአስከናዝን መንግሥታት እንዲወጓት ጥሩ። \q ጥቃቱን የሚመራ አዛዥ ምረጡ። \q እንደ አንበጣ መንጋ የሚመስሉ ብዙ ፈረሶችን ላኩ።

hi.L: देश में झंडा खड़ा करो; जातियों में नरसिंगा फूँको; उसके विरुद्ध जातियों को पवित्र करो; \q उसके विरुद्ध अरारात, मिन्नी और अशकनज़ के राज्यों को बुलाओ; \q उसके विरुद्ध एक सेनानायक ठहराओ; \q घोड़ों को खड़े रोओंवाली टिड्डियों की तरह चढ़ा लाओ।
hi.B: देश में झंडा खड़ा करो! देशों में नरसिंगा फूँको! देशों को उसके विरुद्ध पवित्र युद्ध के लिए अलग करो; \q उसके विरुद्ध अरारात, मिन्नी और अशकनज़ के राज्यों को बुलाओ! \q उसके विरुद्ध एक सेनापति ठहराओ; \q घोड़ों को टिड्डियों के खड़े पंखोंवाले दल की तरह चढ़ा लाओ!
hi.R: देश में झंडा खड़ा करो! देशों में नरसिंगा फूँको! देशों को बाबुल से लड़ने के लिए तैयार करो। \q अरारात, मिन्नी और अशकनज़ के राज्यों को उस पर हमला करने के लिए बुलाओ। \q हमले की अगुवाई करने के लिए एक सेनापति चुनो। \q इतने घोड़े भेजो कि वे टिड्डियों के दल जैसे दिखाई दें।

ru.L: Поднимите знамя на земле, трубите в трубу среди народов, освятите против него народы; \q созовите против него царства Арарата, Минни и Аскеназа; \q поставьте против него полководца; \q поднимите коней, как щетинистую саранчу.
ru.B: Поднимите знамя в стране! Трубите в рог среди народов! Посвятите против него народы для священной войны; \q созовите на него царства Арарата, Минни и Аскеназа! \q Поставьте против него военачальника; \q пошлите коней, как тучу щетинистой саранчи!
ru.R: Поднимите знамя в стране! Трубите в трубу среди народов! Приготовьте народы к войне против Вавилона. \q Призовите царства Арарата, Минни и Аскеназа напасть на него. \q Выберите командира, чтобы он повёл наступление. \q Пошлите столько коней, чтобы они были как туча саранчи.

ja.L: 地に旗を揚げよ。国々の間で角笛を吹け。それに向かって国々を聖別せよ。 \q それに向かって、アララト、ミンニ、アシュケナズの王国を呼び集めよ。 \q それに向かって徴募の長を任命せよ。 \q 毛を逆立てたいなごのように、馬を上らせよ。
ja.B: 地に合図の旗を掲げよ！国々の間で角笛を吹き鳴らせ！それに向かって国々を聖別して戦いに備えさせよ。 \q それに向かって、アララト、ミンニ、アシュケナズの王国を呼び集めよ！ \q それに向かって司令官を立てよ。 \q 毛を逆立てたいなごの大群のように、馬を攻め上らせよ！
ja.R: 地に合図の旗を立てるがいい！国々の間で角笛を吹くがいい！国々にバビロンと戦う準備をさせるがいい。 \q アララト、ミンニ、アシュケナズの王国を呼んで、バビロンを攻めさせるがいい。 \q 攻撃を指揮する司令官を選ぶがいい。 \q いなごの大群のように見えるほど、たくさんの馬を送るがいい。

decisions.choice: Ararat, Minni and Ashkenaz: peoples of the mountains north of Babylon
decisions.reason: Ararat is the kingdom of Urartu, in the mountains of what is now Armenia and eastern Turkey (Genesis 8:4; 2 Kings 19:37). Minni is the land of the Manneans, south of Lake Urmia. Ashkenaz is usually linked with the Scythians, horsemen of the north (Genesis 10:3). In the sixth century BC these lands were under the rule of the Medes (verse 28), who would bring them against Babylon.

decisions.choice: consecrate: prepare for war with religious rites
decisions.reason: War was begun with sacrifices and acts that set the soldiers apart, so the verb "make holy" came to mean "prepare for battle" (6:4; 22:7; Joel 4:9).

decisions.choice: marshal: an officer who musters troops
decisions.reason: The word, borrowed from the language of Babylon, names an official, here one who calls up and arranges an army. It appears only here and in Nahum 3:17.

decisions.choice: bristling locusts: locusts at a stage when their wings stand up stiff
decisions.reason: The word for "bristling" is used only here and may describe young locusts whose wings are still in stiff sheaths, or the rough hair of the horses' manes. Either way, the cavalry comes like a swarm (verse 14).

decisions.choice: ram's horn (B); Prepare the nations for holy war (B); commander (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced says "ram's horn" for the *shofar*, as Isaiah does. Balanced and Readable say what "consecrate" means here (m2) and use "commander" for the marshal.

decisions.choice: consagren naciones (L); preparen a las naciones para la guerra santa (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Consecrate" here means to prepare for a holy war; Literal keeps the word.

decisions.choice: A-ra-rát, Min-ni, Ách-kê-na; tướng chỉ huy
decisions.reason: The kingdoms of the north, written in the pattern of the published names (A-ra-rát as Genesis 8:4); the marshal is "tướng chỉ huy", as the English Balanced and Readable say "commander".

decisions.choice: "구별하다" (L), "거룩한 전쟁을 위하여 구별하다" (B) for "consecrate"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: nations made ready for war with religious rites; Readable says simply "get ready to fight", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "아라랏", "민니", "아스그나스"
decisions.reason: The Protestant forms (아라랏 Gen 8:4; 아스그나스 Gen 10:3).

decisions.choice: Ararate, Mini, Asquenaz; o chifre de carneiro (L, B), a trombeta (R)
decisions.reason: The peoples (m1) take the forms Genesis 8:4 and 10:3 give them in Portuguese; the horn keeps the wording 4:5 sets for the book.

decisions.choice: the shofar is "መለከት" (Literal, Readable) and "የቀንድ መለከት" (Balanced), as the Kings list; "consecrate nations" is "ቀድሱ" (Literal), "ለተቀደሰ ጦርነት ለዩ" (Balanced).
decisions.reason: Ararat and Ashkenaz keep the forms of Genesis 8:4 and 10:3 on main; Minni is "ሚኒ".

decisions.choice: "अरारात, मिन्नी, अशकनज़"
decisions.reason: Ararat as Genesis 8:4 and 2 Kings 19:37; Ashkenaz as Genesis 10:3; Minni transliterated.

decisions.choice: "नरसिंगा"
decisions.reason: The shofar is "नरसिंगा", as the poetry note.

decisions.choice: "सेनापति"
decisions.reason: Literal says "सेनानायक" for the marshal (tifsar); Balanced and Readable say "सेनापति" (commander), as the English does.

decisions.choice: Арарат, Минни, Аскеназ
decisions.reason: Ararat keeps the form of Genesis 8:4 and Ashkenaz of Genesis 10:3 in this translation; Minni, a people of the mountains north of Babylon (m1), is transcribed from the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: освятите (L); посвятите ... для священной войны (B); приготовьте ... к войне (R)
decisions.reason: To consecrate here is to prepare for war with religious rites (m2); Literal keeps the verb, Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: полководец (L); военачальник (B); командир (R)
decisions.reason: An officer who musters troops (m3).

decisions.choice: Ararat "アララト" (2KI 19:37), Minni "ミンニ" (new), Ashkenaz "アシュケナズ" (GEN 10:3); shofar "角笛" at every level (JER rule, the English R says trumpet); qaddeshu "聖別せよ" (L, B), R by the sense; tifsar "徴募の長" (L), "司令官" (B, R).
decisions.reason: m1, m3: the established names and the JER shofar rule.

source.text: קַדְּשׁ֨וּ עָלֶ֤יהָ גוֹיִם֙ אֶת־מַלְכֵ֣י מָדַ֔י אֶת־פַּחוֹתֶ֖יהָ וְאֶת־כָּל־סְגָנֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־אֶ֥רֶץ מֶמְשַׁלְתּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Consecrate against her nations, [the] kings of Media, her governors and all her officials and all [the] land of his dominion.

en.L: Consecrate nations against her, the kings of the Medes, \q their governors and all their officials, \q and all the land of their dominion.
en.B: Set apart nations for holy war against her: the kings of the Medes, \q with their governors and all their officials, \q and every land they rule.
en.R: Get the nations ready to fight against Babylon: the kings of the Medes, \q together with their governors and officials, \q and all the lands under their rule.

es.L: {{plural_you:Consagren|Consagrad}} contra ella naciones, a los reyes de los medos, \q a sus gobernadores y a todos sus magistrados, \q y a toda la tierra de su dominio.
es.B: {{plural_you:Preparen|Preparad}} a las naciones para la guerra santa contra ella: a los reyes de los medos, \q con sus gobernadores y todos sus funcionarios, \q y a todas las tierras que dominan.
es.R: {{plural_you:Preparen|Preparad}} a las naciones para pelear contra Babilonia: a los reyes de los medos, \q junto con sus gobernadores y funcionarios, \q y a todas las tierras que gobiernan.

fr.L: Consacrez contre elle des nations, les rois des Mèdes, \q leurs gouverneurs et tous leurs magistrats, \q et tout le pays de leur domination.
fr.B: Préparez des nations à la guerre sainte contre elle : les rois des Mèdes, \q avec leurs gouverneurs et tous leurs magistrats, \q et tous les pays qu’ils dominent.
fr.R: Préparez les nations à combattre Babylone : les rois des Mèdes, \q avec leurs gouverneurs et leurs magistrats, \q et tous les pays qu’ils gouvernent.

sw.L: Yawekeni mataifa wakfu juu yake, wafalme wa Wamedi, \q maliwali wao na maafisa wao wote, \q na nchi yote ya mamlaka yao.
sw.B: Yawekeni mataifa tayari kwa vita vitakatifu dhidi yake: wafalme wa Wamedi, \q pamoja na maliwali wao na maafisa wao wote, \q na kila nchi wanayoitawala.
sw.R: Yaandaeni mataifa kupigana na Babeli: wafalme wa Wamedi, \q pamoja na maliwali wao na maafisa wao, \q na nchi zote zilizo chini ya utawala wao.

vi.L: Hãy biệt riêng các dân tộc ra để đánh nó, các vua Mê-đi, \q các tổng đốc và mọi quan chức của họ, \q cùng cả xứ thuộc quyền cai trị của họ.
vi.B: Hãy biệt riêng các dân tộc cho cuộc thánh chiến nghịch cùng nó: các vua Mê-đi, \q cùng các tổng đốc và mọi quan chức của họ, \q và mọi xứ họ cai trị.
vi.R: Hãy chuẩn bị các dân tộc chiến đấu chống lại Ba-by-lôn: các vua Mê-đi, \q cùng với các tổng đốc và các quan chức của họ, \q và mọi xứ dưới quyền cai trị của họ.

ko.L: 민족들을 구별하여 그를 치게 하여라. 메대의 왕들과 \q 그 총독들과 그 모든 관리와 \q 그가 다스리는 모든 땅을 [구별하여라].
ko.B: 거룩한 전쟁을 위하여 민족들을 구별하여 그를 치게 하여라. 메대의 왕들과 \q 그들의 총독들과 모든 관리들과 \q 그들이 다스리는 모든 땅을 구별하여라.
ko.R: 민족들이 바빌론과 싸울 준비를 하게 하여라. 메대의 왕들과 \q 그들의 총독들과 관리들과 \q 그들이 다스리는 모든 땅이 준비하게 하여라.

pt.L: Consagrem nações contra ela, os reis dos medos, \q os seus governadores e todos os seus oficiais, \q e toda a terra do seu domínio.
pt.B: Separem nações para a guerra santa contra ela: os reis dos medos, \q com os seus governadores e todos os seus oficiais, \q e toda terra que eles governam.
pt.R: Preparem as nações para lutar contra a Babilônia: os reis dos medos, \q junto com os seus governadores e oficiais, \q e todas as terras que eles governam.

am.L: ሕዝቦችን በእርሷ ላይ ቀድሱ፤ የሜዶንን ነገሥታት፣ \q አገረ ገዦቻቸውንና ሹማምንቶቻቸውን ሁሉ፣ \q የግዛታቸውንም ምድር ሁሉ።
am.B: ሕዝቦችን ለተቀደሰ ጦርነት በእርሷ ላይ ለዩ፤ የሜዶንን ነገሥታት፣ \q ከአገረ ገዦቻቸውና ከሹማምንቶቻቸው ሁሉ ጋር፣ \q የሚገዙትንም ምድር ሁሉ።
am.R: ሕዝቦችን ባቢሎንን ለመውጋት አዘጋጁ፤ የሜዶንን ነገሥታት፣ \q ከአገረ ገዦቻቸውና ከባለ ሥልጣናቶቻቸው ጋር፣ \q በእነርሱም ሥር ያሉትን ምድሮች ሁሉ።

hi.L: उसके विरुद्ध जातियों को पवित्र करो, मादियों के राजाओं को, \q उनके राज्यपालों और उनके सब हाकिमों को, \q और उनके राज्य के सारे देश को।
hi.B: देशों को उसके विरुद्ध पवित्र युद्ध के लिए अलग करो: मादियों के राजाओं को, \q उनके राज्यपालों और उनके सब अधिकारियों को, \q और उस हर देश को जिस पर वे राज्य करते हैं।
hi.R: देशों को बाबुल से लड़ने के लिए तैयार करो: मादियों के राजाओं को, \q और उनके साथ उनके राज्यपालों और अधिकारियों को, \q और उन सब देशों को जो उनके अधीन हैं।

ru.L: Освятите против него народы, царей Мидии, \q их наместников и всех их начальников, \q и всю землю их владычества.
ru.B: Посвятите против него народы для священной войны: царей Мидии \q с их наместниками и всеми начальниками, \q и все земли, которыми они правят.
ru.R: Приготовьте народы к войне против Вавилона: царей Мидии \q вместе с их правителями и начальниками, \q и все земли, которыми они правят.

ja.L: それに向かって国々を聖別せよ。メディアの王たち、 \q その総督たちとそのすべての長官たち、 \q またその支配するすべての地を。
ja.B: それに向かって国々を聖別して戦いに備えさせよ。メディアの王たちと、 \q その総督たちとすべての長官たち、 \q またその支配するすべての地を。
ja.R: 国々にバビロンと戦う準備をさせるがいい。メディアの王たちと、 \q その総督や役人たちと、 \q その支配下にあるすべての国々に。

decisions.choice: her governors ... his dominion: the rulers and lands under Media
decisions.reason: The pronouns shift: "her" refers to Media as a land, and "his" to its king, or to each king. The sense is the whole Median empire with all its subject peoples.

decisions.choice: governors and officials
decisions.reason: As in verse 23. Media's governors and officials ruled the lands named in verse 27.

decisions.choice: their governors ... their dominion
decisions.reason: English uses "their" for the shifting pronouns (m1), since they all point to the Medes and their kings.

decisions.choice: их ... их ... их
decisions.reason: The Hebrew pronouns shift (her governors, his dominion), all pointing to the Medes and their kings (m1); Russian says "их" throughout, as the English says "their".

source.text: וַתִּרְעַ֥שׁ הָאָ֖רֶץ וַתָּחֹ֑ל כִּ֣י קָ֤מָה עַל־בָּבֶל֙ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת יְהוָ֔ה לָשׂ֞וּם אֶת־אֶ֧רֶץ בָּבֶ֛ל לְשַׁמָּ֖ה מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב׃

records.literal_gloss: And quakes the land and writhes, for stand against Babylon [the] plans of Yahweh to make [the] land of Babylon a desolation without inhabitant.

en.L: And the land quakes and writhes, \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s plans against Babylon stand, \q to make the land of Babylon a desolation without inhabitant.
en.B: The land trembles and writhes in pain, \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s plans against Babylon stand firm: \q to make the land of Babylon a wasteland where no one lives.
en.R: The land shakes and twists in pain, \q because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will do what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} planned against Babylon. \q He will make the land of Babylon an empty wasteland where no one lives.

es.L: Y tiembla la tierra y se retuerce, \q porque se cumplen contra Babilonia los designios {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q para convertir la tierra de Babilonia en desolación sin habitante.
es.B: La tierra tiembla y se retuerce de dolor, \q porque los planes {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} contra Babilonia siguen firmes: \q convertir la tierra de Babilonia en un desierto donde nadie viva.
es.R: La tierra tiembla y se retuerce de dolor, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hará lo que planeó contra Babilonia. \q Convertirá la tierra de Babilonia en un desierto vacío donde nadie vive.

fr.L: Et la terre tremble et se tord, \q car les desseins {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} contre Babylone s’accomplissent, \q pour faire du pays de Babylone une désolation sans habitant.
fr.B: La terre tremble et se tord de douleur, \q car les desseins {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} contre Babylone tiennent bon : \q faire du pays de Babylone un désert où personne n’habite.
fr.R: La terre tremble et se tord de douleur, \q parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} va faire ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a prévu contre Babylone. \q Il fera du pays de Babylone un désert vide où personne n’habite.

sw.L: Nayo nchi inatetemeka na kugaagaa kwa maumivu, \q kwa maana mipango ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} juu ya Babeli inasimama, \q kuifanya nchi ya Babeli kuwa ukiwa bila mkaaji.
sw.B: Nchi inatetemeka na kugaagaa kwa uchungu, \q kwa maana mipango ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} dhidi ya Babeli inasimama imara: \q kuifanya nchi ya Babeli nyika isiyo na mtu anayeishi humo.
sw.R: Nchi inatikisika na kujipinda kwa maumivu, \q kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atafanya yale aliyoyapanga dhidi ya Babeli. \q Ataifanya nchi ya Babeli kuwa nyika tupu isiyo na mtu.

vi.L: Đất rúng động và quằn quại, \q vì các kế hoạch của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nghịch cùng Ba-by-lôn đứng vững, \q để làm cho xứ Ba-by-lôn thành hoang vu, không người ở.
vi.B: Đất run rẩy và quằn quại đau đớn, \q vì các kế hoạch của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nghịch cùng Ba-by-lôn đứng vững: \q làm cho xứ Ba-by-lôn thành hoang địa không người ở.
vi.R: Đất rung chuyển và quằn quại đau đớn, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ làm điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã định nghịch cùng Ba-by-lôn. \q Ngài sẽ biến xứ Ba-by-lôn thành hoang địa không người ở.

ko.L: 그리고 땅이 흔들리며 몸부림친다. \q 바빌론에 대한 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 계획이 서서, \q 바빌론 땅을 사는 사람이 없는 황무지로 만들 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 땅이 진동하며 몸부림친다. \q 바빌론에 대한 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 계획이 굳게 서 있기 때문이다. \q 바빌론 땅을 아무도 살지 않는 황무지로 만드시려는 계획이다.
ko.R: 땅이 흔들리고 아파서 몸부림친다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 바빌론에 대하여 계획하신 일을 반드시 이루실 것이기 때문이다. \q 그분께서 바빌론 땅을 아무도 살지 않는 텅 빈 황무지로 만드실 것이다.

pt.L: E a terra treme e se contorce, \q pois os planos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} contra a Babilônia permanecem, \q para fazer da terra da Babilônia uma desolação sem morador.
pt.B: A terra estremece e se contorce de dor, \q pois os planos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} contra a Babilônia continuam firmes: \q fazer da terra da Babilônia um deserto onde ninguém mora.
pt.R: A terra treme e se contorce de dor, \q porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} vai fazer o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} planejou contra a Babilônia. \q Ele vai transformar a terra da Babilônia num deserto vazio onde ninguém mora.

am.L: ምድሪቱም ትናወጣለች፤ ትጨነቃለችም፤ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} አሳብ በባቢሎን ላይ ጸንቷልና፤ \q የባቢሎንን ምድር የሚኖርባት የሌለ ባድማ ያደርግ ዘንድ።
am.B: ምድሪቱ ትንቀጠቀጣለች፤ በሥቃይም ትጨነቃለች፤ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ዕቅድ በባቢሎን ላይ ጸንቶ ቆሟልና፤ \q ይኸውም የባቢሎንን ምድር ሰው የማይኖርበት ምድረ በዳ ማድረግ ነው።
am.R: ምድሪቱ ትናወጣለች፤ በሥቃይም ትጣመማለች፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በባቢሎን ላይ ያቀደውን ያደርጋልና። \q የባቢሎንን ምድር ማንም የማይኖርበት ባዶ ምድረ በዳ ያደርጋታል።

hi.L: और देश काँपता है और तड़पता है, \q क्योंकि बाबुल के विरुद्ध {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की योजनाएँ अटल हैं, \q कि बाबुल देश को ऐसा उजाड़ बना दें जिसमें कोई निवासी न हो।
hi.B: देश काँप उठता है और पीड़ा से तड़पता है, \q क्योंकि बाबुल के विरुद्ध {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की योजनाएँ अटल हैं: \q कि बाबुल देश को ऐसा उजाड़ बना दें जहाँ कोई न रहे।
hi.R: देश काँपता है और पीड़ा से छटपटाता है, \q क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} बाबुल के विरुद्ध वही करेंगे जिसकी उन्होंने योजना बनाई है। \q वे बाबुल देश को ऐसा सूना उजाड़ बना देंगे जहाँ कोई नहीं रहता।

ru.L: И содрогается земля и корчится, \q ведь исполняются против Вавилона замыслы {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} — \q сделать землю Вавилона пустошью без жителя.
ru.B: Земля дрожит и корчится от боли, \q ведь замыслы {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} против Вавилона непоколебимы: \q сделать землю Вавилона пустыней, где никто не живёт.
ru.R: Земля трясётся и корчится от боли, \q потому что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сделает то, что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} задумал против Вавилона. \q Он превратит землю Вавилона в пустую пустыню, где никто не живёт.

ja.L: 地は揺れ動き、もだえる。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のバビロンに対する計画が成るからだ。 \q バビロンの地を、住む者のない荒れ地とするために。
ja.B: 地は震え、もだえ苦しむ。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のバビロンに対する計画が揺るがないからだ。 \q それは、バビロンの地を、だれも住まない荒れ地とするためである。
ja.R: 地は揺れ、苦しんでもだえる。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が、バビロンに対して計画されたことを行われるからだ。 \q その方は、バビロンの地を、だれも住まない荒れ地にされる。

decisions.choice: writhes: twists in pain, as in childbirth
decisions.reason: The verb is used of a woman in labor (4:31) and of the earth shaking at God's coming (Psalm 97:4). The land of Babylon shakes at what is coming.

decisions.choice: stand: are carried out and cannot be changed
decisions.reason: A plan that "stands" holds firm and comes to pass (44:28-29; Isaiah 14:24; 46:10).

decisions.choice: will do what he planned
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what it means for a plan to stand (m2).

source.text: חָדְלוּ֩ גִבּוֹרֵ֨י בָבֶ֜ל לְהִלָּחֵ֗ם יָֽשְׁבוּ֙ בַּמְּצָד֔וֹת נָשְׁתָ֥ה גְבוּרָתָ֖ם הָי֣וּ לְנָשִׁ֑ים הִצִּ֥יתוּ מִשְׁכְּנֹתֶ֖יהָ נִשְׁבְּר֥וּ בְרִיחֶֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Cease [the] warriors of Babylon to fight; they sit in the strongholds; dried up [is] their strength; they have become women; they have set on fire her dwellings; broken [are] her bars.

en.L: The warriors of Babylon have ceased to fight; they sit in the strongholds; \q their strength has dried up; they have become women; \q her dwellings are set on fire; her bars are broken.
en.B: Babylon's warriors have stopped fighting; they stay in their strongholds. \q Their strength is gone; they have become like women. \q Her houses are set on fire; the bars of her gates are broken.
en.R: Babylon's soldiers have stopped fighting. They stay inside their forts. \q Their strength is gone. They have lost all their courage. \q Her houses are burning. The bars that lock her gates are broken.

es.L: Los valientes de Babilonia dejaron de pelear; se quedan en las fortalezas; \q se agotó su fuerza; se volvieron como mujeres; \q incendiaron sus moradas; quebrados están sus cerrojos.
es.B: Los guerreros de Babilonia han dejado de pelear; se quedan en sus fortalezas. \q Se les acabó la fuerza; se han vuelto como mujeres. \q Sus casas han sido incendiadas; los cerrojos de sus puertas están rotos.
es.R: Los soldados de Babilonia han dejado de pelear. Se quedan dentro de sus fuertes. \q Se les acabó la fuerza. Han perdido todo el valor. \q Sus casas están ardiendo. Las trancas de sus puertas están rotas.

fr.L: Les guerriers de Babylone ont cessé de combattre ; ils restent dans les forteresses ; \q leur force s’est tarie ; ils sont devenus des femmes ; \q on a mis le feu à ses demeures ; ses verrous sont brisés.
fr.B: Les guerriers de Babylone ont cessé le combat ; ils restent dans leurs forteresses. \q Leur force est épuisée ; ils sont devenus comme des femmes. \q Ses maisons sont incendiées, les verrous de ses portes sont brisés.
fr.R: Les soldats de Babylone ont cessé de se battre. Ils restent dans leurs forteresses. \q Ils n’ont plus de force. Ils ont perdu tout courage. \q Ses maisons brûlent. Les barres qui ferment ses portes sont brisées.

sw.L: Mashujaa wa Babeli wameacha kupigana; wanakaa ngomeni; \q nguvu zao zimekauka; wamekuwa wanawake; \q makao yake yamechomwa moto; makomeo yake yamevunjika.
sw.B: Mashujaa wa Babeli wameacha kupigana; wamekaa ndani ya ngome zao. \q Nguvu zao zimekwisha; wamekuwa kama wanawake. \q Nyumba zake zimechomwa moto; makomeo ya malango yake yamevunjika.
sw.R: Askari wa Babeli wameacha kupigana. Wanakaa ndani ya ngome zao. \q Nguvu zao zimekwisha. Wamepoteza ujasiri wao wote. \q Nyumba zake zinaungua. Makomeo yanayofunga malango yake yamevunjika.

vi.L: Các dũng sĩ Ba-by-lôn đã thôi chiến đấu; chúng ngồi trong các đồn lũy; \q sức lực chúng đã cạn kiệt; chúng đã trở nên như đàn bà; \q nhà cửa nó bị đốt cháy; các then cửa nó bị bẻ gãy.
vi.B: Các dũng sĩ Ba-by-lôn đã thôi chiến đấu; chúng ở lì trong các đồn lũy. \q Sức lực chúng đã cạn; chúng đã trở nên như đàn bà. \q Nhà cửa nó bị phóng hỏa; then cài cổng nó bị bẻ gãy.
vi.R: Quân lính Ba-by-lôn đã thôi chiến đấu. Chúng ở yên trong các đồn lũy. \q Sức lực chúng đã hết. Chúng mất hết can đảm. \q Nhà cửa nó đang cháy. Then cài các cổng thành nó đã bị bẻ gãy.

ko.L: 바빌론의 용사들이 싸우기를 그치고 요새에 앉아 있다. \q 그들의 힘이 말라 버렸고, 그들이 여자들이 되었다. \q 그의 거처들이 불타고, 그의 빗장들이 부서졌다.
ko.B: 바빌론의 용사들은 싸우기를 그치고 요새 안에 머물러 있다. \q 그들의 힘이 다 빠져서 여자처럼 되었다. \q 바빌론의 집들이 불타고, 성문 빗장들이 부서졌다.
ko.R: 바빌론의 군인들은 싸우기를 멈추었다. 그들은 요새 안에 숨어 있다. \q 그들의 힘이 다 빠졌다. 그들은 용기를 모두 잃었다. \q 바빌론의 집들이 불타고 있다. 성문을 잠그는 빗장들이 부서졌다.

pt.L: Os guerreiros da Babilônia deixaram de lutar; ficam sentados nas fortalezas; \q a força deles secou; tornaram-se mulheres; \q as suas moradas foram incendiadas; as suas trancas foram quebradas.
pt.B: Os guerreiros da Babilônia pararam de lutar; ficam nas suas fortalezas. \q A força deles acabou; ficaram como mulheres. \q As suas casas foram incendiadas; as trancas das suas portas foram quebradas.
pt.R: Os soldados da Babilônia pararam de lutar. Ficam dentro dos seus fortes. \q A força deles acabou. Perderam toda a coragem. \q As suas casas estão pegando fogo. As trancas que fecham as suas portas foram quebradas.

am.L: የባቢሎን ኃያላን መዋጋትን ተዉ፤ በምሽጎች ውስጥ ተቀምጠዋል፤ \q ኃይላቸው ደርቋል፤ ሴቶች ሆነዋል፤ \q መኖሪያዎቿ ተቃጥለዋል፤ መወርወሪያዎቿ ተሰብረዋል።
am.B: የባቢሎን ጦረኞች መዋጋት አቁመዋል፤ በምሽጎቻቸው ውስጥ ተቀምጠዋል። \q ኃይላቸው ጠፍቷል፤ እንደ ሴቶች ሆነዋል። \q ቤቶቿ በእሳት ተቃጥለዋል፤ የበሮቿ መወርወሪያዎች ተሰብረዋል።
am.R: የባቢሎን ወታደሮች መዋጋት አቁመዋል። በምሽጎቻቸው ውስጥ ተቀምጠዋል። \q ኃይላቸው ጠፍቷል። ድፍረታቸውን ሁሉ አጥተዋል። \q ቤቶቿ እየተቃጠሉ ነው። በሮቿን የሚቆልፉት መወርወሪያዎች ተሰብረዋል።

hi.L: बाबुल के वीर योद्धा लड़ना छोड़ चुके हैं; वे गढ़ों में बैठे हैं; \q उनका बल सूख गया है; वे स्त्रियाँ बन गए हैं; \q उसके निवासस्थानों में आग लगा दी गई है; उसके बेंड़े तोड़ दिए गए हैं।
hi.B: बाबुल के वीर योद्धाओं ने लड़ना छोड़ दिया है; वे अपने गढ़ों में ही बैठे रहते हैं। \q उनका बल जाता रहा है; वे स्त्रियों जैसे हो गए हैं। \q उसके घरों में आग लगा दी गई है; उसके फाटकों के बेंड़े तोड़ दिए गए हैं।
hi.R: बाबुल के सैनिकों ने लड़ना बंद कर दिया है। वे अपने क़िलों के भीतर ही रहते हैं। \q उनकी शक्ति जाती रही है। उनका सारा साहस टूट गया है। \q उसके घर जल रहे हैं। उसके फाटकों को बंद करनेवाले बेंड़े टूट गए हैं।

ru.L: Перестали воины-богатыри Вавилона сражаться, сидят в крепостях; \q иссякла их сила, стали они женщинами; \q подожжены его жилища, сломаны его засовы.
ru.B: Воины Вавилона перестали сражаться; они сидят в своих крепостях. \q Их сила иссякла; они стали как женщины. \q Его дома подожжены; засовы его ворот сломаны.
ru.R: Воины Вавилона перестали сражаться. Они сидят в своих крепостях. \q У них не осталось сил. Они совсем потеряли мужество. \q Его дома горят. Засовы на его воротах сломаны.

ja.L: バビロンの勇士たちは戦うのをやめ、要害の中に座り込み、 \q その力は尽き、女になった。 \q その住まいは焼かれ、そのかんぬきは折られた。
ja.B: バビロンの勇士たちは戦うのをやめ、要害にとどまっている。 \q その力は尽き、女のようになった。 \q その家々は火をつけられ、門のかんぬきは折られた。
ja.R: バビロンの兵士たちは、戦うのをやめた。砦の中にこもっている。 \q 力はなくなり、すっかり勇気を失った。 \q 町の家々は燃え、門を閉ざすかんぬきは折れた。

decisions.choice: they have become women: they have lost their nerve for battle
decisions.reason: In the language of ancient war, to say that soldiers "become women" meant that they had lost the strength and courage to fight and had become helpless (50:37; Isaiah 19:16; Nahum 3:13). The saying reflects the warfare of the time, in which women did not fight; it describes fear, not a judgment on women.

decisions.choice: the strongholds: the fortresses where they shelter
decisions.reason: The warriors do not go out to fight but stay behind their walls, which do not save them.

decisions.choice: her bars: the bars that lock the city gates
decisions.reason: Gates were closed with heavy bars of wood or bronze (49:31; Lamentations 2:9). Broken bars mean the city lies open.

decisions.choice: like women (B); They have lost all their courage (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced adds "like" to mark the comparison; Readable says what the idiom means (m1). Balanced and Readable say "the bars of her gates" to make the picture clear.

decisions.choice: "여자들이 되었다" (L); "여자처럼 되었다" (B); "용기를 모두 잃었다" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture, Balanced makes it a comparison, Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: воины-богатыри (L); воины (B, R)
decisions.reason: The gibborim, as in 49:22.

decisions.choice: стали как женщины (B); потеряли мужество (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced marks the comparison and Readable says what the idiom means (m1), as the English does; Literal keeps "стали женщинами".

decisions.choice: "女になった" (L), "女のようになった" (B), "勇気を失った" (R), as 50:37; metsadot "要害" (L, B), "砦" (R), as 48:41.
decisions.reason: m1: the idiom in the 50:37 forms.

source.text: רָ֤ץ לִקְרַאת־רָץ֙ יָר֔וּץ וּמַגִּ֖יד לִקְרַ֣את מַגִּ֑יד לְהַגִּיד֙ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל כִּֽי־נִלְכְּדָ֥ה עִיר֖וֹ מִקָּצֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Runner to meet runner runs, and messenger to meet messenger, to tell [the] king of Babylon that has been captured his city from [the] end.

en.L: Runner runs to meet runner, \q and messenger to meet messenger, \q to tell the king of Babylon \q that his city has been captured from end [to end].
en.B: One runner runs to meet another, \q one messenger to meet the next, \q to tell the king of Babylon \q that his city has been taken from end to end.
en.R: One runner after another hurries to the king of Babylon. \q One messenger after another comes with news. \q They tell the king \q that his whole city has been captured.

es.L: Corredor corre al encuentro de corredor, \q y mensajero al encuentro de mensajero, \q para anunciar al rey de Babilonia \q que su ciudad ha sido tomada de un extremo [a otro].
es.B: Un corredor corre al encuentro de otro, \q un mensajero al encuentro del siguiente, \q para anunciar al rey de Babilonia \q que su ciudad ha sido tomada de un extremo a otro.
es.R: Un corredor tras otro corre hacia el rey de Babilonia. \q Un mensajero tras otro llega con noticias. \q Le dicen al rey \q que toda su ciudad ha sido conquistada.

fr.L: Le coureur court à la rencontre du coureur, \q et le messager à la rencontre du messager, \q pour annoncer au roi de Babylone \q que sa ville est prise d’un bout [à l’autre].
fr.B: Un coureur court au-devant d’un autre, \q un messager au-devant d’un autre messager, \q pour annoncer au roi de Babylone \q que sa ville est prise d’un bout à l’autre.
fr.R: Les coureurs se succèdent auprès du roi de Babylone. \q Les messagers arrivent l’un après l’autre avec des nouvelles. \q Ils annoncent au roi \q que toute sa ville a été prise.

sw.L: Tarishi anakimbia kumlaki tarishi, \q na mjumbe kumlaki mjumbe, \q kumwambia mfalme wa Babeli \q kwamba mji wake umetwaliwa kutoka mwisho [hadi mwisho].
sw.B: Tarishi mmoja anakimbia kumlaki mwingine, \q mjumbe mmoja kumlaki mwenzake, \q kumwambia mfalme wa Babeli \q kwamba mji wake umetekwa kutoka mwisho hadi mwisho.
sw.R: Tarishi mmoja baada ya mwingine wanakimbia kwa mfalme wa Babeli. \q Mjumbe mmoja baada ya mwingine wanakuja na habari. \q Wanamwambia mfalme \q kwamba mji wake wote umetekwa.

vi.L: Người chạy tin chạy đón người chạy tin, \q sứ giả đón sứ giả, \q để báo cho vua Ba-by-lôn \q rằng thành vua đã bị chiếm từ đầu [đến cuối].
vi.B: Người chạy tin này chạy đón người chạy tin khác, \q sứ giả này đón sứ giả kia, \q để báo cho vua Ba-by-lôn \q rằng thành vua đã bị chiếm từ đầu đến cuối.
vi.R: Hết người chạy tin này đến người chạy tin khác vội vã đến với vua Ba-by-lôn. \q Hết sứ giả này đến sứ giả khác mang tin đến. \q Họ báo cho vua \q rằng cả thành của vua đã bị chiếm.

ko.L: 달리는 자가 달리는 자를 맞으러 달려가고, \q 전령이 전령을 맞으러 [달려가서], \q 바빌론 왕에게 \q 그의 성이 끝에서 [끝까지] 점령되었다고 알린다.
ko.B: 달리는 자가 잇달아 달려가고, \q 전령이 잇달아 전령을 맞으러 가서, \q 바빌론 왕에게 \q 그의 성이 이 끝에서 저 끝까지 함락되었다고 알린다.
ko.R: 달리는 사람들이 잇달아 바빌론 왕에게 급히 달려간다. \q 전령들이 잇달아 소식을 가지고 온다. \q 그들이 왕에게 \q 그의 성 전체가 점령되었다고 알린다.

pt.L: Corredor corre ao encontro de corredor, \q e mensageiro ao encontro de mensageiro, \q para anunciar ao rei da Babilônia \q que a sua cidade foi tomada de ponta [a ponta].
pt.B: Um corredor corre ao encontro de outro, \q um mensageiro ao encontro do seguinte, \q para anunciar ao rei da Babilônia \q que a sua cidade foi tomada de ponta a ponta.
pt.R: Um corredor atrás do outro corre até o rei da Babilônia. \q Um mensageiro atrás do outro chega com notícias. \q Eles contam ao rei \q que a sua cidade inteira foi capturada.

am.L: ሯጭ ሯጭን ሊገናኝ ይሮጣል፤ \q መልእክተኛም መልእክተኛን [ሊገናኝ]፤ \q ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ \q ከተማው ከዳር [እስከ ዳር] እንደ ተያዘች ይነግሩ ዘንድ።
am.B: አንዱ ሯጭ ሌላውን ሊገናኝ ይሮጣል፤ \q መልእክተኛም ከሌላው መልእክተኛ ጋር ይገናኛል፤ \q ለባቢሎን ንጉሥ \q ከተማው ከዳር እስከ ዳር እንደ ተያዘች ሊነግሩት።
am.R: ሯጮች አንዱ ከሌላው ተከትለው ወደ ባቢሎን ንጉሥ ይሮጣሉ። \q መልእክተኞችም አንዱ ከሌላው ተከትለው ወሬ ይዘው ይመጣሉ። \q ለንጉሡ \q ከተማው በሙሉ እንደ ተያዘች ይነግሩታል።

hi.L: दौड़नेवाला दौड़नेवाले से मिलने को दौड़ता है, \q और संदेशवाहक संदेशवाहक से मिलने को, \q कि बाबुल के राजा को बताएँ \q कि उसका नगर छोर से [छोर तक] ले लिया गया है।
hi.B: एक हरकारा दूसरे से मिलने को दौड़ता है, \q एक संदेशवाहक दूसरे से मिलने को, \q कि बाबुल के राजा को समाचार दें \q कि उसका नगर एक छोर से दूसरे छोर तक ले लिया गया है।
hi.R: एक के बाद एक हरकारा बाबुल के राजा के पास दौड़ा आता है। \q एक के बाद एक संदेशवाहक समाचार लेकर आता है। \q वे राजा को बताते हैं \q कि उसका सारा नगर शत्रु के हाथ में आ गया है।

ru.L: Гонец бежит навстречу гонцу, \q и вестник навстречу вестнику, \q чтобы возвестить царю Вавилона, \q что взят его город с края [до края].
ru.B: Один гонец бежит навстречу другому, \q один вестник навстречу следующему, \q чтобы сообщить царю Вавилона, \q что его город взят из конца в конец.
ru.R: Один гонец за другим спешит к царю Вавилона. \q Один вестник за другим приходит с новостями. \q Они говорят царю, \q что весь его город захвачен.

ja.L: 走者は走者に出会うために走り、 \q 使者は使者に出会うために[走る]。 \q バビロンの王に告げるためである。 \q その都が端から攻め取られたと。
ja.B: 走る者が次々に走り、 \q 使者が次々に走って行く。 \q バビロンの王に告げるためだ。 \q その都が隅々まで攻め取られたと。
ja.R: 伝令が次々に、バビロンの王のもとへ急いで行く。 \q 使者が次々に、知らせを持って来る。 \q 彼らは王に告げる。 \q 都全体が攻め落とされたと。

decisions.choice: runner to meet runner: messengers coming one after another from every part of the city
decisions.reason: Kings received news by runners (2 Samuel 18:19-27). Here they meet one another on the way, each bringing word from a different quarter, until the king learns that the whole city has fallen.

decisions.choice: from end to end: from every side, the whole city
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "from the end", meaning from its outer edge, on every side (50:26).

decisions.choice: from end [to end]
decisions.reason: Literal supplies the words English needs for the phrase (m2).

source.text: וְהַמַּעְבָּר֣וֹת נִתְפָּ֔שׂוּ וְאֶת־הָאֲגַמִּ֖ים שָׂרְפ֣וּ בָאֵ֑שׁ וְאַנְשֵׁ֥י הַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה נִבְהָֽלוּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And the fords have been seized, and the reed marshes they have burned with fire, and the men of war are terrified.

en.L: And the fords have been seized, \q and the reed marshes they have burned with fire, \q and the men of war are terrified.
en.B: The river crossings are seized, \q the marshes of reeds are set on fire, \q and the soldiers are in panic.
en.R: The enemy has taken the places where people cross the river. \q They have set fire to the reeds in the marshes. \q Babylon's soldiers are terrified.

es.L: Y los vados han sido tomados, \q y los cañaverales quemados con fuego, \q y los hombres de guerra están aterrados.
es.B: Los pasos del río han sido tomados, \q los cañaverales de los pantanos arden en llamas, \q y los soldados están llenos de pánico.
es.R: El enemigo ha tomado los lugares por donde la gente cruza el río. \q Han prendido fuego a los juncos de los pantanos. \q Los soldados de Babilonia están aterrados.

fr.L: Et les gués ont été saisis, \q et les marais de roseaux, on les a brûlés par le feu, \q et les hommes de guerre sont épouvantés.
fr.B: Les passages du fleuve sont occupés, \q les marais de roseaux sont livrés aux flammes, \q et les soldats sont pris de panique.
fr.R: L’ennemi a pris les endroits où l’on traverse le fleuve. \q Ils ont mis le feu aux roseaux des marais. \q Les soldats de Babylone sont terrifiés.

sw.L: Na vivuko vimekamatwa, \q na matete ya madimbwi wameyachoma kwa moto, \q na watu wa vita wametishika.
sw.B: Vivuko vya mto vimetekwa, \q matete ya madimbwi yamechomwa moto, \q na askari wamejaa hofu.
sw.R: Adui wameyateka mahali ambapo watu huvuka mto. \q Wameyachoma moto matete ya madimbwi. \q Askari wa Babeli wanaogopa sana.

vi.L: Các bến đò đã bị chiếm, \q các đầm sậy đã bị lửa đốt, \q và quân lính kinh hoàng.
vi.B: Các chỗ vượt sông đã bị chiếm, \q các đầm lau sậy đã bị phóng hỏa, \q và quân lính hoảng loạn.
vi.R: Quân thù đã chiếm các chỗ người ta qua sông. \q Chúng đã đốt lau sậy trong các đầm lầy. \q Quân lính Ba-by-lôn khiếp sợ.

ko.L: 그리고 나루터들이 점령되었고, \q 갈대 늪지들이 불에 탔으며, \q 군사들이 두려워 떤다.
ko.B: 강을 건너는 나루터들이 점령되고, \q 갈대 늪지들이 불타며, \q 군인들은 겁에 질려 있다.
ko.R: 원수가 사람들이 강을 건너는 곳들을 차지했다. \q 늪지의 갈대에 불을 질렀다. \q 바빌론 군인들은 몹시 두려워하고 있다.

pt.L: E os vaus foram tomados, \q e os juncos queimaram com fogo, \q e os homens de guerra estão apavorados.
pt.B: As passagens do rio foram tomadas, \q os pântanos de juncos foram incendiados, \q e os soldados estão em pânico.
pt.R: O inimigo tomou os lugares onde as pessoas atravessam o rio. \q Puseram fogo nos juncos dos pântanos. \q Os soldados da Babilônia estão apavorados.

am.L: መሻገሪያዎቹም ተያዙ፤ \q ረግረጉንም በእሳት አቃጠሉ፤ \q ተዋጊዎቹም ደነገጡ።
am.B: የወንዝ መሻገሪያዎቹ ተይዘዋል፤ \q የቄጠማ ረግረጎቹ በእሳት ተቃጥለዋል፤ \q ወታደሮቹም ተሸብረዋል።
am.R: ጠላት ሰዎች ወንዙን የሚሻገሩባቸውን ስፍራዎች ይዟል። \q በረግረጉ ያለውን ቄጠማ በእሳት አቃጥለዋል። \q የባቢሎን ወታደሮች በፍርሃት ተውጠዋል።
